sourceBindings.english: From a 2008 national postal survey of 112 SABIO-member beekeepers (22.4% response rate) managing an estimated 19,520 hives at 2,094 apiary sites; figure is self-reported and un-weighted. Table 7 (same doc, p.13-14) shows wide variance by region/operation-focus/size for the same year: e.g. 'All' region, honey-focused, all-size operations = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr across 3 survey sites; Western Cape honey-focused = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; Western Cape pollination-focused, small operations = only 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. The same document also quotes an earlier, more rigorously validated study: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' for Western Cape hives (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, cited p.2 of this working paper), and historical national bee-census data of 8.3 kg/hive/annum (1911-1988 average) rising to 24 kg/hive in the 1974/5 census (same doc, p.1). No single number can be called definitive; 25 kg/hive/yr is used as the document's own headline national estimate.

source.quote: The national average honey yield of in the region of 25 kilograms of honey per hive per year in Table 7 is un-weighted across beekeepers.
source.doc: Survey of Beekeeping in South Africa, CSSR Working Paper No. 221 (Conradie & Nortje, 2008, UCT Centre for Social Science Research)

sourceBindings.english: FAO general backyard target, not a South African observed rate. The 30–35 young per doe annually have reached slaughter or reproduction age after allowance for post-weaning loss; they are not merely weaned and are not kg of meat. The source models six litters and 5.5 surviving young per litter, describing a 30-rabbit objective; an extra litter raises its stated objective to 35. Do not combine this backyard target with grower-house carcass weight from a different trial.

source.quote: For backyard rabbitries, it is as- sumed that weaning takes place at 42 days, servicing at 24 days after kindling, and the average conception rate is 70 percent. This gives an average of six litters per doe per year. ... If an average six young per litter are weaned and 5.5 reach slaughter or reproduction age, the objective is then 30 rabbits per doe annually. This modest goal is realistic for back- yard rabbitries not based exclusively on pelleted feed. ... This would give an additional litter per doe, raising the annual goal to 35 rabbits per doe.
source.doc: FAO Animal Production and Health Series No.21 - The Rabbit: Husbandry, Health and Production (Lebas et al.)

sourceBindings.english: outputUnit is 'lambs born/ewe/year' rather than the suggested 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' or 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': the source explains 'Measuring accurate lambing percentages for smallholder sheep farmers is challenging as these farmers mostly farm extensively and do not keep records', and instead calculates 'Lambs born per ewe (as recorded from the surveys based on interviews with individual respondents)' - a lambing (born), not weaning, figure, self-reported by smallholder farmers rather than measured/weighed. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 lambs born/ewe/year; the range [0.61, 1.39] spans the three Western Cape smallholder districts surveyed (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), all from this one study/quote - not merged with any other document. The same paper separately states a COMMERCIAL extensive benchmark of 110-156% lambing and 94-132% weaning (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), explicitly 'expressed over ewes joined' (a different denominator/system) - not merged into this smallholder range.

source.quote: Lambing percentages averaged 139 ± 38% for the Eden District, 83 ± 15% for the Karoo District, and 61± 12% for the West Coast District.
source.doc: Factors influencing off-take rates of smallholder sheep farming systems in the Western Cape Province of South Africa (South African Journal of Agricultural Extension, 47(3), 2019)

sourceBindings.english: The government sheep manual describes controlled breeding at Mara Research Station, Limpopo: June–July mating and November–December lambing to match rain and grass. This is one station breeding calendar, not mutton harvest months. Match adapted meat-purpose stock and feed locally, then record birth, survival, weaning and actual slaughter or sale; lambs born per ewe are not edible kg.

source.quote: the sheep and goat breeding season in Mara Research Station is in winter (June/July)
source.doc: DAFF: Sheep General Information Manual, Final Draft, section 3.4.6

sourceBindings.english: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.

source.quote: Average Merino fleece weights vary from 4 kg to 5 kg per year in the semi-arid regions, to up to 8 kg per year from sheep grazing on cultivated pastures.
source.doc: Assessing Socio-economic Factors Influencing Wool Production in Kolomana Villages of Eastern Cape, South Africa (South African Journal of Agricultural Extension), citing Bot et al., 2004

rows.english: From a 2008 national postal survey of 112 SABIO-member beekeepers (22.4% response rate) managing an estimated 19,520 hives at 2,094 apiary sites; figure is self-reported and un-weighted. Table 7 (same doc, p.13-14) shows wide variance by region/operation-focus/size for the same year: e.g. 'All' region, honey-focused, all-size operations = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr across 3 survey sites; Western Cape honey-focused = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; Western Cape pollination-focused, small operations = only 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. The same document also quotes an earlier, more rigorously validated study: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' for Western Cape hives (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, cited p.2 of this working paper), and historical national bee-census data of 8.3 kg/hive/annum (1911-1988 average) rising to 24 kg/hive in the 1974/5 census (same doc, p.1). No single number can be called definitive; 25 kg/hive/yr is used as the document's own headline national estimate.
rows.zu: Kusuka ocwaningweni lukazwelonke lwango-2008 olwenziwa ngeposi kubafuyi bezinyosi abangamalungu e-SABIO abangu-112 (abaphendula bangu-22.4%) abaphethe izidleke ezilinganiselwa ku-19,520 ezindaweni zezinyosi ezingu-2,094; leli nani libikwe yibo futhi alikalungiswa ngezilinganiso zesisindo samasampula. Ithebula 7 (umbhalo ofanayo, amakhasi 13-14) likhombisa umehluko omkhulu ngesifunda/ngenhloso yokufuya/ngobukhulu bebhizinisi ngonyaka ofanayo: isibonelo, esifundeni esibizwa ngokuthi 'All', amabhizinisi agxile ojwini abo bonke osayizi = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr ezindaweni zocwaningo ezingu-3; e-Western Cape agxile ojwini = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; e-Western Cape amabhizinisi amancane agxile ekuthuthweni kwempova = kuphela 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. Umbhalo ofanayo uphinde ucaphune ucwaningo lwangaphambilini olwaqinisekiswa ngokucophelela kakhulu: 'Isivuno esimaphakathi abasibikile siphansi kakhulu, singamakhilogremu angu-13.4 kuphela ngesidleke' ezidlekeni zase-Western Cape (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, ecashunwe ekhasini 2 lalo mbiko), kanye nedatha yomlando yokubalwa kwezinyosi kazwelonke engu-8.3 kg/hive/annum (isilinganiso sango-1911-1988) eyakhuphukela ku-24 kg/hive ekubalweni kwango-1974/5 (umbhalo ofanayo, ikhasi 1). Alikho inani elilodwa elingabizwa ngokuthi liyisiphetho esiqinisekile; u-25 kg/hive/yr usetshenziswa njengesilinganiso sikazwelonke esiyinhloko salo mbhalo uqobo.
rows.st: Ho tswa phuputsong ya naha ya poso ya 2008 ya barui ba dinotshi ba 112 bao e leng ditho tsa SABIO (ba arabileng e le 22.4%) ba laolang matlo a dinotshi a hakanyetswang ho 19,520 dibakeng tsa dinotshi tse 2,094; palo e tlalehilwe ke bona mme ha e a lekanngwa ka boima ba disampole. Tafole 7 (tokomane e tshwanang, maq.13-14) e bontsha phapang e kgolo ka sebaka/sepheo sa kgwebo/boholo selemong seo: mohl. sebaka sa 'All', dikgwebo tse shebaneng le mahe a dinotshi tsa boholo bohle = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr dibakeng tse 3 tsa phuputso; tse shebaneng le mahe a dinotshi Western Cape = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; dikgwebo tse nyane tse shebaneng le ho tsamaisa peo ya dipalesa Western Cape = 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr feela. Tokomane e tshwanang e boetse e qotsa phuputso ya pejana e netefaditsweng ka thata ho feta: 'Karolelano ya chai eo ba e tlalehileng e tlase haholo, e le dikilogeramo tse 13.4 feela ka ntlo ya dinotshi' bakeng sa matlo a dinotshi a Western Cape (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, e qotsitswe leq.2 la pampiri ena), le dintlha tsa kgale tsa palo ya dinotshi ya naha tsa 8.3 kg/hive/annum (karolelano ya 1911-1988) tse nyolohelang ho 24 kg/hive palong ya 1974/5 (tokomane e tshwanang, leq.1). Ha ho palo e le nngwe e ka bitswang qeto e tiileng; 25 kg/hive/yr e sebediswa e le kakanyo ya sehlooho ya naha ya tokomane ka boyona.
rows.ts: Ku suka eka ndzavisiso wa tiko wa poso wa 2008 wa vafuwi va tinyoxi va 112 lava nga swirho swa SABIO (lava hlamuleke va ri 22.4%) lava lawulaka tindlu ta tinyoxi leti ringanyetiwaka ku va 19,520 etindhawini ta tinyoxi ta 2,094; nhlayo yi vikiwe hi vona naswona a yi pimiwanga hi ntikelo wa swikombiso. Tafula 7 (tsalwa rin'we, matl.13-14) ri komba ku hambana lokukulu hi xifundzha/xikongomelo xa bindzu/vukulu eka lembe rero: xik. xifundzha xa 'All', mabindzu lama kongomisaka eka vulombe ya vukulu hinkwabyo = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr etindhawini ta ndzavisiso ta 3; ya Western Cape lama kongomisaka eka vulombe = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; mabindzu lamatsongo ya Western Cape lama kongomisaka eka ku rhwala mbewu ya swiluva = 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr ntsena. Tsalwa rin'we ri tlhela ri tshaha ndzavisiso wa khale lowu tiyisisiweke hi vukheta byo tala: 'Avhareji ya ntshovelo lowu va wu vikeke yi le hansi swinene, yi ri tikhilogiramu ta 13.4 ntsena hi yindlu ya tinyoxi' eka tindlu ta tinyoxi ta Western Cape (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, va tshahiwa eka tl.2 ra phepha leri), ni vuxokoxoko bya khale bya nhlayo ya tinyoxi ya tiko bya 8.3 kg/hive/annum (avhareji ya 1911-1988) leyi tlhandlukaka ku ya eka 24 kg/hive eka nhlayo ya 1974/5 (tsalwa rin'we, tl.1). A ku na nhlayo yin'we leyi nga vuriwaka ya makumu leyi tiyeke; 25 kg/hive/yr yi tirhisiwa yi ri mpimanyeto wa tiko lowukulu wa tsalwa hi roxe.
rows.ve: Zwi bva kha ṱhoḓisiso ya lushaka ya poswo ya 2008 ya vhafuwi vha ṋotshi vha 112 vha re miraḓo ya SABIO (ho fhindula 22.4%) vha langaho nnḓu dza ṋotshi dzi anganyelwaho u vha 19,520 kha zwitentsi zwa ṋotshi zwa 2,094; mbalo yo vhigwa nga vhone vhane nahone a yo ngo linganyiswa nga zwileme zwa tsumbonanguludzwa. Thebuḽa 7 (ḽiṅwalwa ḽithihi, masiaṱ.13-14) ḽi sumbedza phambano khulwane u ya nga dzingu/ndivho ya bindu/vhuhulwane kha ṅwaha wonoyo: tsumbo, dzingu ḽa 'All', mabindu a vhuhulwane hoṱhe o livhaho kha mutoli = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr kha zwitentsi zwa ṱhoḓisiso zwa 3; a Western Cape o livhaho kha mutoli = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; mabindu maṱuku a Western Cape o livhaho kha u endedza luvhanda lwa maluvha = 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr fhedzi. Ḽiṅwalwa ḽithihi ḽi dovha ḽa redza ṱhoḓisiso ya kale yo khwaṱhisedzwaho nga vhuronwane vhuhulwane: 'Avhareji ya khaṋo ye vha vhiga i fhasi vhukuma, ndi khilogireme dza 13.4 fhedzi nga nnḓu ya ṋotshi' kha nnḓu dza ṋotshi dza Western Cape (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, vho redzwa kha siaṱ.2 ḽa bammbiri iḽi), na mafhungo a kale a mbalombalo ya ṋotshi dza lushaka a 8.3 kg/hive/annum (avhareji ya 1911-1988) o gonya a vha 24 kg/hive kha mbalombalo ya 1974/5 (ḽiṅwalwa ḽithihi, siaṱ.1). A hu na mbalo nthihi ine ya nga pfi ndi yone ya u fhedza yo khwaṱhisedzwaho; 25 kg/hive/yr i shumiswa sa nyanganyelo khulwane ya lushaka ya ḽiṅwalwa ḽone ḽiṋe.

rows.english: Table 5 gives weaning weight (WW) across four agro-ecological zones for the same nine Nguni communal herds: arid 114.51 kg (lowest), semi-arid 119.98 kg, dry sub-humid 117.91 kg, humid 121.21 kg (highest). The range recorded here spans this one study's own arid-to-humid zone means; it is not merged with any other paper's weaning-weight figures (other SA studies report different ranges for different systems - e.g. research-station or stud herds - and were deliberately excluded to avoid mixing systems). 826 Nguni calves from nine herds that the paper itself says were 'kept under extensive grazing system' in Limpopo Province - a genuine communal/extensive veld system matching this enterprise.
rows.zu: Ithebula 5 linikeza isisindo sokulunyulwa (WW) ezindaweni ezine ezihlukene ngokwemvelo yezolimo semihlambi efanayo eyisishiyagalolunye yezinkomo zama-Nguni zomphakathi: eyomile kakhulu 114.51 kg (ephansi kakhulu), eyomile ngokwengxenye 119.98 kg, enomswakama ongaphansi kodwa eyomile 117.91 kg, enomswakama 121.21 kg (ephezulu kakhulu). Ububanzi obubhalwe lapha buhlanganisa izilinganiso zezindawo ezisukela kwezomile kuya kwezimanzi zalolu cwaningo olulodwa; abuhlanganiswa nezibalo zesisindo sokulunyulwa zanoma yiliphi elinye iphepha (ezinye izifundo zaseNingizimu Afrika zibika ububanzi obuhlukile bezinhlelo ezihlukile - isibonelo, imihlambi yezikhungo zocwaningo noma eyokuzalanisa - futhi zikhishwe ngamabomu ukuze kungaxutshwa izinhlelo). Amankonyane ama-Nguni angu-826 asemihlambini eyisishiyagalolunye iphepha ngokwalo elithi 'igcinwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuklaba emadlelweni abanzi' eSifundazweni saseLimpopo - uhlelo lwangempela lomphakathi/lwamadlelo abanzi oluhambisana nalolu hlobo lokufuya.
rows.st: Tafole 5 e fana ka boima nakong ya ho kgweswa (WW) dibakeng tse nne tsa temo le tikoloho bakeng sa mehlape e tshwanang e robong ya dikgomo tsa Nguni tsa kopanelo: sebaka se omeletseng 114.51 kg (se tlase ka ho fetisisa), se batlang se omme 119.98 kg, se ommeng se nang le mongobo o mahareng 117.91 kg, se mongobo 121.21 kg (se phahameng ka ho fetisisa). Moedi o ngotsweng mona o akaretsa dikarolelano tsa dibaka tse ommeng ho isa ho tse mongobo tsa phuputso ena feela; ha o kopantswe le dipalo tsa boima ba ho kgweswa tsa pampiri efe kapa efe e nngwe (diphuputso tse ding tsa Afrika Borwa di tlaleha meedi e fapaneng bakeng sa mekgwa e fapaneng - mohl. mehlape ya diteishene tsa dipatlisiso kapa ya ho tswadisa - mme e tlohetswe ka boomo ho qoba ho kopanya mekgwa). Manamane a Nguni a 826 a mehlape e robong eo pampiri ka boyona e reng e ne e 'ruilwe ka mokgwa wa makgulo a maholo' Profinseng ya Limpopo - mokgwa wa nnete wa kopanelo/wa makgulo a maholo o tsamaellanang le kgwebo ena.
rows.ts: Tafula 5 ri nyika ntikelo loko ku lumuriwa (WW) eka tindhawu ta mune ta vurimi ni mbango eka mintlhambi yin'we ya kaye ya Nguni ya vaaki: ndhawu yo oma swinene 114.51 kg (ya le hansi swinene), yo oma hi xiphemu 119.98 kg, yo oma leyi nga ni ndzhongho wa le xiringan'weni 117.91 kg, leyi nga ni ndzhongho 121.21 kg (ya le henhla swinene). Mpimo lowu tsariweke laha wu katsa tiavhareji ta tindhawu to oma ku ya eka leti nga ni ndzhongho ta ndzavisiso lowu wun'we; a wu hlanganisiwi ni tinhlayo ta ntikelo wa ku lumuriwa ta phepha rin'wana (mindzavisiso yin'wana ya Afrika-Dzonga yi vika mimpimo leyi hambaneke eka mafambiselo lama hambaneke - xik. mintlhambi ya switichi swa ndzavisiso kumbe ya ku tswalisa - naswona yi susiwile hi vomu ku papalata ku hlanganisa mafambiselo). Marhole ya Nguni ya 826 ya mintlhambi ya kaye leyi phepha hi roxe ri vulaka leswaku a yi 'hlayisiwa hi mafambiselo yo dya madyelo lama anameke' eXifundzheni xa Limpopo - mafambiselo ya xiviri ya vaaki/ya madyelo lama anameke lama fambelanaka ni bindzu leri.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 5 ḽi ṋea tshileme tsha u lumulwa (WW) kha dzingu nṋa dza vhulimi na mupo kha miṱambi yeneyo ya ṱahe ya Nguni ya tshitshavha: fhethu ho omaho 114.51 kg (ha fhasi-fhasi), ho omaho zwiṱuku 119.98 kg, ho omaho hu re na muṋuṋu wa vhukati 117.91 kg, hu re na muṋuṋu 121.21 kg (ha nṱhesa). Mikhano yo ṅwalwaho afha i katela avhareji dza dzingu dzo omaho u ya kha dzi re na muṋuṋu dza ṱhoḓisiso iyi nthihi; a yo ngo ṱanganyiswa na mbalo dza tshileme tsha u lumulwa dza ḽiṅwe bammbiri (dziṅwe ṱhoḓisiso dza Afrika Tshipembe dzi vhiga mikhano yo fhambanaho kha maitele o fhambanaho - tsumbo, miṱambi ya zwititshi zwa ṱhoḓisiso kana ya u bebisa - nahone dzo litshwa nga khole u itela u sa ṱanganyisa maitele). Ndi ṋamana dza Nguni dza 826 dzi bvaho kha miṱambi ya ṱahe ine bammbiri ḽone ḽiṋe ḽa ri yo vha i 'tshi fuwiwa kha maitele a mafulo mahulwane' Vunduni ḽa Limpopo - maitele a vhukuma a tshitshavha/mafulo mahulwane a fanaho na bindu iḽi.

rows.english: 2354 days / 365.25 = 6.44 years. 'Failure time' is the length of productive herd life for the 580 uncensored (fully-observed) records in the combined dataset; the dissertation itself defines productive herd life as 'the time interval between first calving date to culling date'. Combined data from three extensively-grazed Nguni stud herds, animals born 1968-2015.
rows.zu: Izinsuku ezingu-2354 / 365.25 = iminyaka engu-6.44. 'Failure time' yisikhathi sokuphila kokukhiqiza emhlambini samarekhodi angu-580 anganqanyulwanga (abhekwe kuze kube sekupheleni) edatheni ehlanganisiwe; ucwaningo lweziqu ngokwalo luchaza ukuphila kokukhiqiza emhlambini ngokuthi 'isikhawu sesikhathi esiphakathi kosuku lokuzala inkonyane lokuqala nosuku lokukhishwa emhlambini'. Idatha ehlanganisiwe ivela emihlambini emithathu yama-Nguni yokuzalanisa eklaba emadlelweni abanzi, izilwane ezazalwa ngo-1968-2015.
rows.st: Matsatsi a 2354 / 365.25 = dilemo tse 6.44. 'Failure time' ke bolelele ba bophelo ba tlhahiso mohlapeng bakeng sa direkoto tse 580 tse sa kgaotswang (tse shebilweng ho fihlela qetellong) dintlheng tse kopantsweng; sengolwa sa dipatlisiso ka bosona se hlalosa bophelo ba tlhahiso mohlapeng e le 'nako e pakeng tsa letsatsi la ho tswala namane la pele le letsatsi la ho ntshwa mohlapeng'. Dintlha tse kopantsweng di tswa mehlapeng e meraro ya Nguni ya ho tswadisa e fulang makgulong a maholo, diphoofolo tse tswetsweng ka 1968-2015.
rows.ts: Masiku ya 2354 / 365.25 = malembe ya 6.44. 'Failure time' i nkarhi wa vutomi bya vuhumelerisi emintlhambini eka tirhekhodo ta 580 leti nga tsemeleriwangiki (leti langutiweke ku fikela emakumu) eka vuxokoxoko byi hlanganisiweke; tsalwa ra ndzavisiso hi roxe ri hlamusela vutomi bya vuhumelerisi emintlhambini byi ri 'nkarhi lowu nga xikari ka siku ra ku tswala ro sungula ni siku ra ku susiwa entlhambini'. Vuxokoxoko byi hlanganisiweke byi huma eka mintlhambi ya Nguni ya ku tswalisa yinharhu leyi dyaka madyelo lama anameke, swifuwo leswi tswariweke hi 1968-2015.
rows.ve: Maḓuvha a 2354 / 365.25 = miṅwaha ya 6.44. 'Failure time' ndi vhulapfu ha vhutshilo ha vhubveledzi kha muṱambi kha rekhodo dza 580 dzi songo fheliswaho u sedzwa hu sa athu swikiwa magumoni (dzo sedzwaho u swika magumoni) kha mafhungo o ṱanganyiswaho; ḽiṅwalwa ḽa ṱhoḓisiso ḽone ḽiṋe ḽi ṱalusa vhutshilo ha vhubveledzi kha muṱambi sa 'tshifhinga vhukati ha datumu ya u thoma u bebwa ha ṋamana na datumu ya u bviswa muṱambini'. Mafhungo o ṱanganyiswaho a bva kha miṱambi miraru ya Nguni ya u bebisa yo fuwiwaho kha mafulo mahulwane, zwipuka zwo bebwaho nga 1968-2015.

rows.english: Table 1, AFC column, rows in the table's order Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: 28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32 months. The Grade rows used here are Holstein-Friesland 30 and Jersey 28 (Grade Ayrshire 32 is not used: the enterprise is Jersey or Holstein type). 28 x 4.35 = 121.8 weeks; 30 x 4.35 = 130.5 weeks. Milk begins at first calving, so age at first calving is the time to first product.
rows.zu: Ithebula 1, ikholomu ye-AFC, imigqa ilandelana njengoba isethebula: Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: izinyanga ezingu-28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32. Imigqa ye-Grade esetshenziswa lapha yi-Holstein-Friesland engu-30 ne-Jersey engu-28 (i-Grade Ayrshire engu-32 ayisetshenziswa: lolu hlobo lokufuya luyi-Jersey noma i-Holstein). 28 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-121.8; 30 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-130.5. Ubisi luqala lapho kuzalwa inkonyane lokuqala, ngakho ubudala bokuzala inkonyane lokuqala buyisikhathi somkhiqizo wokuqala.
rows.st: Tafole 1, kholomo ya AFC, mela ka tatellano ya tafole Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: dikgwedi tse 28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32. Mela ya Grade e sebediswang mona ke Holstein-Friesland 30 le Jersey 28 (Grade Ayrshire 32 ha e sebediswe: kgwebo ke ya mofuta wa Jersey kapa Holstein). 28 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 121.8; 30 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 130.5. Lebese le qala ha namane ya pele e tswalwa, kahoo dilemo tsa ho tswala namane ya pele ke nako ya sehlahiswa sa pele.
rows.ts: Tafula 1, kholomo ya AFC, tilayini hi ku landzelelana ka tafula Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: tin'hweti ta 28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32. Tilayini ta Grade leti tirhisiwaka laha i Holstein-Friesland 30 na Jersey 28 (Grade Ayrshire 32 a yi tirhisiwi: bindzu i ra muxaka wa Jersey kumbe Holstein). 28 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 121.8; 30 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 130.5. Masi ma sungula loko ku tswariwa rhole ro sungula, hikokwalaho vukhale bya ku tswala ro sungula i nkarhi wa xibveledzwa xo sungula.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 1, khoḽomu ya AFC, mitalo nga mutevhe wa thebuḽa Holstein-Friesland Reg./Grade, Jersey Reg./Grade, Ayrshire Reg./Grade: miṅwedzi ya 28, 30, 25, 28, 29, 32. Mitalo ya Grade i shumiswaho afha ndi Holstein-Friesland 30 na Jersey 28 (Grade Ayrshire 32 a i shumiswi: bindu ndi ḽa lushaka lwa Jersey kana Holstein). 28 x 4.35 = vhege dza 121.8; 30 x 4.35 = vhege dza 130.5. Mafhi a thoma musi hu tshi bebwa ṋamana ya u thoma, ngauralo miṅwaha ya u beba ṋamana ya u thoma ndi tshifhinga tsha tshibveledzwa tsha u thoma.

rows.english: Table 1 ('Comparison of number of cows, production and fertility in the main dairy breeds in South Africa'), Milk column, Grade rows: Jersey 3840 kg and Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg per lactation (Registered rows: 4468 and 6426 kg). The document says these are National Milk Recording Scheme herds, which 'have been shown to be better managed than those outside the scheme, with their performance per lactation being 50 % greater than that of the national herd', so a smallholder herd should expect less.
rows.zu: Ithebula 1 ('Ukuqhathaniswa kwesibalo sezinkomazi, ukukhiqiza nokuzala kwezinhlobo eziyinhloko zobisi eNingizimu Afrika'), ikholomu ethi Milk, imigqa ye-Grade: Jersey 3840 kg ne-Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg ngesikhathi ngasinye sokukhiqiza ubisi (imigqa ye-Registered: 4468 no-6426 kg). Umbhalo uthi le yimihlambi ye-National Milk Recording Scheme, 'ebonakale inakekelwa kangcono kunengaphandle kwalolu hlelo, ukukhiqiza kwayo ngesikhathi ngasinye sobisi kungaphezu kokomhlambi kazwelonke ngo-50 %', ngakho umlimi omncane kufanele alindele okungaphansi kwalokho.
rows.st: Tafole 1 ('Papiso ya palo ya dikgomo tse tshehadi, tlhahiso le kemolo mefuteng e meholo ya lebese Afrika Borwa'), kholomo ya Milk, mela ya Grade: Jersey 3840 kg le Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg ka nako ka nngwe ya tlhahiso ya lebese (mela ya Registered: 4468 le 6426 kg). Tokomane e re ena ke mehlape ya National Milk Recording Scheme, 'eo ho bontshitsweng hore e laolwa hantle ho feta e ka ntle ho lenaneo, tlhahiso ya yona ka nako ka nngwe ya lebese e feta ya mohlape wa naha ka 50 %', kahoo mohlape wa morui e monyane o lokela ho lebella se ka tlase.
rows.ts: Tafula 1 ('Ku fananisa nhlayo ya tihomu ta xisati, vuhumelerisi ni vuswikoti byo tswala eka tinxaka letikulu ta masi eAfrika-Dzonga'), kholomo ya Milk, tilayini ta Grade: Jersey 3840 kg na Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg hi nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana wa masi (tilayini ta Registered: 4468 na 6426 kg). Tsalwa ri vula leswaku leyi i mintlhambi ya National Milk Recording Scheme, 'leyi kombisiweke leswaku yi lawuriwa ku antswa ku hundza leyi nga ehandle ka nongonoko, vuhumelerisi bya yona hi nkarhi wa masi byi ri henhla ka bya ntlhambi wa tiko hi 50 %', hikokwalaho ntlhambi wa murimi lontsongo wu fanele ku langutela leswi nga ehansi.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 1 ('U vhambedza tshivhalo tsha kholomo dza tshisadzi, vhubveledzi na vhukoni ha u beba kha tshaka khulwane dza mafhi Afrika Tshipembe'), khoḽomu ya Milk, mitalo ya Grade: Jersey 3840 kg na Holstein-Friesland 5422 kg nga tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha u ṋea mafhi (mitalo ya Registered: 4468 na 6426 kg). Ḽiṅwalwa ḽi ri iyi ndi miṱambi ya National Milk Recording Scheme, 'ye ya sumbedzwa uri i langwa khwine u fhira i re nnḓa ha mbekanyamushumo, vhubveledzi hayo nga tshifhinga tsha mafhi vhu fhira ha muṱambi wa lushaka nga 50 %', ngauralo muṱambi wa mufuwi muṱuku u tea u lavhelela zwi re fhasi ha izwi.

rows.english: Holstein 739.33 and Jersey 696.81 days of productive life (first calving to culling) in South African milk-recorded herds, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 and 739.33/365.25 = 2.02 years.
rows.zu: I-Holstein izinsuku ezingu-739.33 ne-Jersey ezingu-696.81 zokuphila kokukhiqiza (kusukela ekuzaleni inkonyane lokuqala kuya ekukhishweni emhlambini) emihlambini yaseNingizimu Afrika erekhodelwa ubisi, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 no-739.33/365.25 = iminyaka engu-2.02.
rows.st: Holstein matsatsi a 739.33 le Jersey a 696.81 a bophelo ba tlhahiso (ho tloha ho tswaleng namane ya pele ho isa ho ntshwa mohlapeng) mehlapeng ya Afrika Borwa e rekotelwang lebese, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 le 739.33/365.25 = dilemo tse 2.02.
rows.ts: Holstein masiku ya 739.33 na Jersey ya 696.81 ya vuhumelerisi (ku suka eka ku tswala rhole ro sungula ku ya eka ku susiwa entlhambini) eka mintlhambi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi rhekhodiwaka masi, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 na 739.33/365.25 = malembe ya 2.02.
rows.ve: Holstein maḓuvha a 739.33 na Jersey a 696.81 a vhutshilo ha vhubveledzi (u bva kha u beba ṋamana ya u thoma u swika kha u bviswa muṱambini) kha miṱambi ya Afrika Tshipembe i re na rekhodo dza mafhi, 2000-2019: 696.81/365.25 = 1.91 na 739.33/365.25 = miṅwaha ya 2.02.

rows.english: Dry-matter (DM) intake for lactating dairy cows: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Full span across both breeds used here (14 to 28 kg/day) since the enterprise covers Jersey, Holstein or crossbred cows generically.
rows.zu: Ukudla kwento eyomile (DM) ezinkomazini zobisi ezisancelisa: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Kusetshenziswa lapha ububanzi obugcwele bezinhlobo zombili (14 kuya ku-28 kg/day) ngoba lolu hlobo lokufuya luhlanganisa ngokujwayelekile izinkomazi ze-Jersey, Holstein noma eziyimixube.
rows.st: Dijo tse jewang di balwa e le taba e ommeng (DM) bakeng sa dikgomo tsa lebese tse anyesang: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Ho sebediswa moedi o felletseng wa mefuta eo ka bobedi mona (14 ho isa ho 28 kg/day) hobane kgwebo e akaretsa dikgomo tsa Jersey, Holstein kapa tse tswakaneng ka kakaretso.
rows.ts: Swakudya leswi dyiwaka swi pimiwa ku ri swilo swo oma (DM) eka tihomu ta masi leti mamisaka: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Ku tirhisiwa mpimo lowu heleleke wa tinxaka hatimbirhi laha (14 ku ya eka 28 kg/day) hikuva bindzu ri katsa tihomu ta Jersey, Holstein kumbe leti hlanganisiweke hi ku angarhela.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwine zwa ḽiwa zwi tshi pimiwa sa zwithu zwo omaho (DM) kha kholomo dza mafhi dzi mamisaho: Jersey 14-16 kg DM/day, Holstein 24-28 kg DM/day. Hu shumiswa mikhano yo fhelelaho ya tshaka dzoṱhe mbili afha (14 u ya kha 28 kg/day) ngauri bindu ḽi katela nga u angaredza kholomo dza Jersey, Holstein kana dzo ṱanganyiswaho.

rows.english: Table 21.1 gives water intake for a lactating Holstein-type cow under comfortable versus hot conditions: 58 L/day (comfortable) to 75 L/day (hot). Used as the general lactating-cow range; not broken out by breed since the table's other columns are for comfort/heat-stress states rather than breed.
rows.zu: Ithebula 21.1 linikeza amanzi aphuzwa yinkomazi yohlobo lwe-Holstein esancelisa ezimweni ezinethezekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezishisayo: 58 L/day (ezinethezekile) kuya ku-75 L/day (ezishisayo). Lokhu kusetshenziswa njengobubanzi obujwayelekile bezinkomazi ezisancelisa; akuhlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ngoba amanye amakholomu ethebula awokuzizwa kahle/ukucindezelwa ukushisa kunokuba abe ngezinhlobo.
rows.st: Tafole 21.1 e fana ka metsi a nowang ke kgomo ya mofuta wa Holstein e anyesang maemong a phutholohileng ha a bapiswa le a tjhesang: 58 L/day (a phutholohileng) ho isa ho 75 L/day (a tjhesang). E sebediswa e le moedi wa kakaretso wa dikgomo tse anyesang; ha e arolwe ka mofuta hobane dikholomo tse ding tsa tafole ke tsa maemo a phutholoho/kgatello ya mocheso ho ena le mofuta.
rows.ts: Tafula 21.1 ri nyika mati lama nwiwaka hi homu ya muxaka wa Holstein leyi mamisaka eka swiyimo swo tshamiseka loko swi fananisiwa ni swo hisa: 58 L/day (ku tshamiseka) ku ya eka 75 L/day (ku hisa). Yi tirhisiwa yi ri mpimo wo angarhela wa tihomu leti mamisaka; a yi avanyisiwi hi muxaka hikuva tikholomo tin'wana ta tafula ti ri ta ku tshamiseka/ku tshikileriwa hi ku hisa ku nga ri ta muxaka.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 21.1 ḽi ṋea maḓi ane kholomo ya lushaka lwa Holstein i mamisaho ya nwa kha nyimele dzo takadzaho dzi tshi vhambedzwa na dzi fhisaho: 58 L/day (dzo takadzaho) u ya kha 75 L/day (dzi fhisaho). Zwi shumiswa sa mikhano ya u angaredza ya kholomo dzi mamisaho; a zwo ngo khethekanywa nga lushaka ngauri dziṅwe khoḽomu dza thebuḽa ndi dza nyimele dza u takala/mutsiko wa mufhiso hu si lushaka.

rows.english: In hotter, humid KZN, KZN DARD describes Nguni × Jersey dairy trials at Makhathini to combine milk potential with local adaptation. Hand milking with the calf present highlights competition between household milk and calf growth. Discuss adapted stock and feeding locally; commercial milk-recording totals do not forecast this system. Record calving, lactation stage and milk available after calf needs.
rows.zu: Ezindaweni ezishisayo nezinomswakama zase-KZN, i-KZN DARD ichaza ukuhlolwa kwezinkomo zobisi ze-Nguni × Jersey eMakhathini ukuze kuhlanganiswe amandla obisi nokujwayela indawo. Ukusenga ngesandla inkonyane likhona kugqamisa ukuncintisana phakathi kobisi lwasekhaya nokukhula kwenkonyane. Xoxa ngendawo ngezilwane ezijwayele indawo nokondla; izamba zamarekhodi obisi ezohwebo azibikezeli lolu hlelo. Rekhoda ukuzala kwenkonyane, isigaba sokukhiqiza ubisi nobisi olusele ngemva kwezidingo zenkonyane.
rows.st: Dibakeng tse tjhesang, tse mongobo tsa KZN, KZN DARD e hlalosa diteko tsa dikgomo tsa lebese tsa Nguni × Jersey Makhathini ho kopanya bokgoni ba lebese le ho ikamahanya le sebaka. Ho hama ka letsoho namane e le teng ho bontsha tlhodisano pakeng tsa lebese la lelapa le kgolo ya namane. Buisanang sebakeng sa heno ka diphoofolo tse ikamahantseng le sebaka le phepo; dipalo tsohle tsa direkoto tsa lebese tsa kgwebo ha di bolele sephetho sa mokgwa ona esale pele. Rekota ho tswalwa ha namane, mohato wa tlhahiso ya lebese le lebese le fumanehang ka mora ditlhoko tsa namane.
rows.ts: Etindhawini ta KZN leti hisaka swinene naswona ti nga ni ndzhongho, KZN DARD yi hlamusela mindzavisiso ya tihomu ta masi ta Nguni × Jersey eMakhathini ku hlanganisa vuswikoti bya masi ni ku tolovela ndhawu. Ku senga hi mavoko rhole ri ri kona swi komba ku phikizana ka masi ya muti ni ku kula ka rhole. Burisanani endhawini hi swifuwo leswi tolovelaka ndhawu ni ku phamela; tinhlayo ta masi leti rhekhodiweke eka mabindzu a ti vhumbi mafambiselo lawa. Rhekhoda ku tswala rhole, xiyimo xa masi ni masi lama kumekaka endzhaku ka swilaveko swa rhole.
rows.ve: Kha fhethu ha KZN hu fhisaho nga maanḓa hu dovha ha vha na muṋuṋu, KZN DARD i ṱalusa milingo ya kholomo dza mafhi dza Nguni × Jersey ngei Makhathini u itela u ṱanganyisa vhukoni ha mafhi na u ḓowela fhethu. U hama nga zwanḓa ṋamana i hone zwi sumbedza muṱa na ṋamana zwi tshi ṱoḓa mafhi eneo mathihi u itela u shumisa muṱani na u alusa ṋamana. Ambani henefho nga zwipuka zwo ḓowelaho fhethu na u zwi fha zwiḽiwa; ṱhanganyelo dza rekhodo dza mafhi dza mabindu a dzi vhumbi maitele aya. Ṅwalani u bebwa ha ṋamana, ḽiga ḽa u ṋea mafhi na mafhi ane a sala nga murahu ha zwine ṋamana ya ṱoḓa.

rows.english: 32 days / 7 = 4.57 weeks; 33 days / 7 = 4.71 weeks. This enterprise has a single grow-out cycle ending in slaughter, so 'time to first product' = age at slaughter. South Africa, commercial industry average.
rows.zu: Izinsuku ezingu-32 / 7 = amasonto angu-4.57; izinsuku ezingu-33 / 7 = amasonto angu-4.71. Lolu hlobo lokufuya lunomjikelezo owodwa wokukhulisa ophela ngokuhlatshwa, ngakho 'isikhathi somkhiqizo wokuqala' = ubudala bokuhlatshwa. INingizimu Afrika, isilinganiso semboni yokuhweba.
rows.st: Matsatsi a 32 / 7 = dibeke tse 4.57; matsatsi a 33 / 7 = dibeke tse 4.71. Kgwebo ena e na le potoloho e le nngwe ya kgodiso e qetellang ka ho hlajwa, kahoo 'nako ya sehlahiswa sa pele' = dilemo ha phoofolo e hlajwa. Afrika Borwa, karolelano ya indasteri ya kgwebo.
rows.ts: Masiku ya 32 / 7 = mavhiki ya 4.57; masiku ya 33 / 7 = mavhiki ya 4.71. Bindzu leri ri ni ndzhendzheleko wun'we wa ku kurisa lowu helaka hi ku tlhava, hikokwalaho 'nkarhi wa xibveledzwa xo sungula' = vukhale loko ku tlhaviwa. Afrika-Dzonga, avhareji ya indasitiri ya mabindzu.
rows.ve: Maḓuvha a 32 / 7 = vhege dza 4.57; maḓuvha a 33 / 7 = vhege dza 4.71. Bindu iḽi ḽi na mutevhe muthihi wa u alusa u fhelaho nga u ṱhavha, ngauralo 'tshifhinga tsha tshibveledzwa tsha u thoma' = miṅwaha musi hu tshi ṱhavhiwa. Afrika Tshipembe, avhareji ya nḓowetshumo ya mabindu.

rows.english: National commercial broiler industry average, South Africa, 2022. A separate breed-trial table (Table 4b, same document, p.39) gives named-strain 'Cumulative FI (kg)' and 'Body weight (kg)' at exactly 35 days: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (cumulative feed intake 3.21-3.64kg) - a slightly older age (35 vs 32-33 days) and higher weight than the industry-wide average quoted above; not merged into the primary figure since it is a different (breed-standard trial) dataset, but used below for the feed-intake figure.
rows.zu: Isilinganiso semboni yezinkukhu zenyama zokuhweba sikazwelonke, eNingizimu Afrika, 2022. Elinye ithebula lokuhlolwa kwezinhlobo (Ithebula 4b, umbhalo ofanayo, ikhasi 39) linikeza 'Cumulative FI (kg)' kanye 'Body weight (kg)' yezinhlobo ezishiwo ngamagama zinezinsuku ezingu-35 ngqo: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (ukudla okudliwe kuhlanganisiwe 3.21-3.64kg) - ubudala obuthe xaxa (35 uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsuku ezingu-32-33) nesisindo esiphakeme kunesilinganiso semboni yonke esicashunwe ngenhla; akuhlanganiswa nenani eliyinhloko ngoba leyo yidatha ehlukile (yokuhlolwa kwamazinga ezinhlobo), kodwa isetshenziswa ngezansi enanini lokudla okudliwe.
rows.st: Karolelano ya naha ya indasteri ya dikgogo tsa nama tsa kgwebo, Afrika Borwa, 2022. Tafole e fapaneng ya teko ya mefuta (Tafole 4b, tokomane e tshwanang, leq.39) e fana ka 'Cumulative FI (kg)' le 'Body weight (kg)' bakeng sa mefuta e bitsitsweng ka mabitso matsatsing a 35 hantle: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (dijo tsohle tse jelweng 3.21-3.64kg) - dilemo tse fetang hanyane (35 ha ho bapiswa le matsatsi a 32-33) le boima bo phahameng ho feta karolelano ya indasteri yohle e qotsitsweng ka hodimo; ha e kopantswe le palo e ka sehloohong hobane ke sehlopha sa dintlha se fapaneng (sa teko ya maemo a mefuta), empa e sebediswa ka tlase bakeng sa palo ya dijo tse jelweng.
rows.ts: Avhareji ya tiko ya indasitiri ya tihuku ta nyama ta mabindzu, Afrika-Dzonga, 2022. Tafula rin'wana ra ndzavisiso wa tinxaka (Tafula 4b, tsalwa rin'we, tl.39) ri nyika 'Cumulative FI (kg)' na 'Body weight (kg)' ta tinxaka leti boxiweke hi mavito eka masiku ya 35 hi ku kongoma: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (swakudya hinkwabyo leswi dyiweke 3.21-3.64kg) - vukhale byo engeteleka katsongo (35 loko ku fananisiwa ni masiku ya 32-33) ni ntikelo wo tlakuka ku hundza avhareji ya indasitiri hinkwato leyi tshahiweke laha henhla; a swi hlanganisiwi ni nhlayo leyikulu hikuva i vuxokoxoko byin'wana (bya ndzavisiso wa swipimelo swa tinxaka), kambe swi tirhisiwa laha hansi eka nhlayo ya swakudya leswi dyiweke.
rows.ve: Avhareji ya lushaka ya nḓowetshumo ya khuhu dza ṋama dza mabindu, Afrika Tshipembe, 2022. Ḽiṅwe thebuḽa ḽa mulingo wa tshaka (Thebuḽa 4b, ḽiṅwalwa ḽithihi, siaṱ.39) ḽi ṋea 'Cumulative FI (kg)' na 'Body weight (kg)' zwa tshaka dzo bulwaho nga madzina kha maḓuvha a 35 kokotolo: Arbor Acres Plus 2.29kg, Cobb 500 2.52kg, Indian River 2.30kg, Ross 308 2.30kg (ṱhanganyelo ya zwiḽiwa zwo ḽiwaho 3.21-3.64kg) - miṅwaha yo engedzeaho zwiṱuku (35 zwi tshi vhambedzwa na maḓuvha a 32-33) na tshileme tshi re nṱha ha avhareji ya nḓowetshumo yoṱhe yo redzwaho afho nṱha; a zwi ṱanganyiswi na mbalo khulwane ngauri ndi mafhungo o fhambanaho (a mulingo wa zwipimo zwa tshaka), fhedzi zwi shumiswa afho fhasi kha mbalo ya zwiḽiwa zwo ḽiwaho.

rows.english: Newer South African commercial reference: SAPA 2024 reports average slaughter at 30–31 days with bird weight 1.8–1.85 kg. The primary range above remains the earlier 2022 reference at 32–33 days. These are commercial bird weights, not dressed meat kg or a village flock target. Record hatch or purchase age, feeding system, actual harvest date and weighed product basis.
rows.zu: Isikhombo esisha sokuhweba saseNingizimu Afrika: i-SAPA 2024 ibika isilinganiso sokuhlatshwa ezinsukwini ezingu-30–31 izinkukhu zinesisindo esingu-1.8–1.85 kg. Ububanzi obuyinhloko obungenhla buhlala buyisikhombo sangaphambilini sango-2022 sezinsuku ezingu-32–33. Lezi yizisindo zezinkukhu zokuhweba, hhayi ama-kg enyama elungisiwe noma okuhloswe ngomhlambi wasemakhaya. Rekhoda ubudala bokuchanyuselwa noma bokuthengwa, indlela yokondla, usuku lwangempela lokuvuna kanye nokuthi umkhiqizo okaliwe ulinganiswe kanjani.
rows.st: Tshupiso e ntjha ya kgwebo ya Afrika Borwa: SAPA 2024 e tlaleha karolelano ya ho hlajwa ka matsatsi a 30–31 ka boima ba kgogo ba 1.8–1.85 kg. Moedi o ka sehloohong ka hodimo o sala e le tshupiso ya pejana ya 2022 matsatsing a 32–33. Tsena ke boima ba dikgogo tsa kgwebo, eseng kg ya nama e lokisitsweng kapa sepheo sa mohlape wa motseng. Rekota dilemo ho tloha ho qhotswa kapa ha ho rekwa, mokgwa wa phepo, letsatsi la nnete la kotulo le motheo wa sehlahiswa se lekantsweng.
rows.ts: Xikombo lexintshwa xa mabindzu xa Afrika-Dzonga: SAPA 2024 yi vika avhareji ya ku tlhava eka masiku ya 30–31 hi ntikelo wa huku wa 1.8–1.85 kg. Mpimo lowukulu lowu nga laha henhla wu sala wu ri xikombo xa khale xa 2022 eka masiku ya 32–33. Leyi i mintikelo ya tihuku ta mabindzu, ku nga ri kg ta nyama leyi lunghisiweke kumbe xikongomelo xa ntlhambi wa le migangeni. Rhekhoda vukhale bya ku tlhotlhoriwa kumbe bya loko ti xaviwa, mafambiselo ya swakudya, siku ra xiviri ro tshovela ni leswi pimelo ra xibveledzwa lexi kariweke ri yimelaka swona.
rows.ve: Tshikombo tshiswa tsha mabindu tsha Afrika Tshipembe: SAPA 2024 i vhiga avhareji ya u ṱhavha kha maḓuvha a 30–31 khuhu i na tshileme tsha 1.8–1.85 kg. Mikhano mihulwane i re afho nṱha i sala i tshikombo tsha kale tsha 2022 kha maḓuvha a 32–33. Hezwi ndi zwileme zwa khuhu dza mabindu, hu si kg ya ṋama yo lugiselwaho kana tshipikwa tsha muṱambi wa mahayani. Ṅwalani miṅwaha u bva kha u thothonya kana musi hu tshi rengwa, maitele a zwiḽiwa, datumu ya vhukuma ya khaṋo na uri tshibveledzwa tsho kaliwaho tsho pimiwa tshi kha tshivhumbeo tshifhio.

rows.english: Free-range village chickens, KwaZulu-Natal; dry-environment birds started laying earlier (15.74 weeks) than wet-environment birds (27.78 weeks), difference flagged significant ('*') in the source table. Wide range reflects genuine dry/wet-season environmental variation reported by the source, not measurement uncertainty.
rows.zu: Izinkukhu zasemakhaya ezizihambelayo, KwaZulu-Natal; ezendawo eyomile zaqala ukubekela ngaphambi (amasonto angu-15.74) kwalezo zendawo emanzi (amasonto angu-27.78), umehluko umakwe njengobalulekile ngokwezibalo ('*') ethebuleni lomthombo. Ububanzi obukhulu buveza ukwehluka kwangempela kwezimo zendawo ezomile/ezimanzi okubikwa ngumthombo, hhayi ukungaqiniseki kokukala.
rows.st: Dikgogo tsa metseng tse tsamayang ka bolokolohi, KwaZulu-Natal; tsa tikoloho e ommeng di qadile ho behela kapele (dibeke tse 15.74) ho feta tsa tikoloho e metsi (dibeke tse 27.78), phapang e tshwailwe e le ya bohlokwa ka dipalopalo ('*') tafoleng ya mohlodi. Moedi o pharaletseng o bontsha phapang ya nnete ya tikoloho ya sehla se ommeng/se metsi e tlalehilweng ke mohlodi, eseng ho se tiisehe ha tekanyo.
rows.ts: Tihuku ta le migangeni leti fambafambaka ehandle, KwaZulu-Natal; ta ndhawu yo oma ti sungule ku tshikela ka ha ri na nkarhi (mavhiki ya 15.74) ku hundza ta ndhawu leyi tsakamaka (mavhiki ya 27.78), ku hambana ku funghiwile ku ri ka nkoka hi tinhlayohlayo ('*') eka tafula ra xihlovo. Mpimo wo anama wu komba ku hambana ka xiviri ka mbango wa nguva yo oma/yo tsakama loku vikiweke hi xihlovo, ku nga ri ku nga tiyiseki ka mpimo.
rows.ve: Khuhu dza mahayani dzi ḓitshimbilelaho nnḓa, KwaZulu-Natal; dza fhethu ho omaho dzo thoma u kudzela nga u ṱavhanya (vhege dza 15.74) u fhira dza fhethu hu ṋukalaho (vhege dza 27.78), phambano yo swaiwa sa i re ya ndeme nga mbalombalo ('*') kha thebuḽa ḽa tshiko. Mikhano yo ṱanḓavhuwaho i sumbedza phambano ya vhukuma ya mupo kha khalaṅwaha yo omaho/hu ṋukalaho yo vhigwaho nga tshiko, hu si u sa khwaṱhisedzea ha mupimo.

rows.english: Free-range/scavenging village chickens, KwaZulu-Natal: dry (40.43) vs wet (49.91) environment, difference not significant ('NS'). A managed-system ARC Irene trial of named indigenous breeds (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) reports far higher counts, now separately verified and retained in productionReferences; managed conditions cannot replace this village range.
rows.zu: Izinkukhu zasemakhaya ezizihambelayo/ezizifunela ukudla, KwaZulu-Natal: indawo eyomile (40.43) uma kuqhathaniswa nemanzi (49.91), umehluko awubalulekile ngokwezibalo ('NS'). Ukuhlolwa kwe-ARC Irene ngaphansi kohlelo olulawulwayo kwezinhlobo zendabuko ezishiwo ngamagama (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) kubika izibalo eziphakeme kakhulu, manje eseziqinisekiswe ngokwehlukana futhi zigcinwe ku-productionReferences; izimo ezilawulwayo azikwazi ukuthatha indawo yalobu bubanzi basemakhaya.
rows.st: Dikgogo tsa metseng tse tsamayang ka bolokolohi/tse ipatlelang dijo, KwaZulu-Natal: tikoloho e ommeng (40.43) ha e bapiswa le e metsi (49.91), phapang ha e ya bohlokwa ka dipalopalo ('NS'). Teko ya ARC Irene tlasa mokgwa o laolwang ya mefuta ya setso e bitsitsweng ka mabitso (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) e tlaleha dipalo tse phahameng haholo, jwale di netefaditswe ka thoko mme di bolokilwe ho productionReferences; maemo a laolwang a ke ke a nkela moedi ona wa motseng sebaka.
rows.ts: Tihuku ta le migangeni leti fambafambaka ehandle/ti lava swakudya hi toxe, KwaZulu-Natal: mbango wo oma (40.43) loko wu fananisiwa ni lowu tsakamaka (49.91), ku hambana a hi ka nkoka hi tinhlayohlayo ('NS'). Ndzavisiso wa ARC Irene eka mafambiselo lama lawuriwaka wa tinxaka ta ndhavuko leti boxiweke hi mavito (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) wu vika tinhlayo leti tlakukeke swinene, sweswi ti tiyisisiweke hi ku hambana ni ku hlayisiwa eka productionReferences; swiyimo leswi lawuriwaka a swi nge sivi mpimo lowu wa le migangeni.
rows.ve: Khuhu dza mahayani dzi ḓitshimbilelaho nnḓa/dzi ḓilavelaho zwiḽiwa, KwaZulu-Natal: mupo wo omaho (40.43) u tshi vhambedzwa na u ṋukalaho (49.91), phambano a si ya ndeme nga mbalombalo ('NS'). Mulingo wa ARC Irene kha maitele a langwaho wa tshaka dza sialala dzo bulwaho nga madzina (Grobbelaar, Sutherland & Molalakgotla 2010, Animal Genetic Resources 46: 25-32) u vhiga mbalo dza nṱha nga maanḓa, zwino dzo khwaṱhisedzwaho nga thungo dza vhulungwa kha productionReferences; nyimele dza maitele a langwaho a dzi nga dzhii vhudzulo ha mikhano iyi ya mahayani.

rows.english: The ARC Irene trial compared Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck under commercial feed, water and controlled lighting. Mean eggs/hen in a 52-week cycle were 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 and 138.9 respectively; first-egg ages were 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 and 129.0 days from hatch, with no significant first-egg age difference among breeds. This is managed breed context, not the yield of scavenging hens in KZN. Match feeding and housing before using a benchmark.
rows.zu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-ARC Irene kwaqhathanisa i-Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo ne-Naked Neck ngaphansi kokudla kokuhweba, amanzi nokukhanyisa okulawulwayo. Isilinganiso samaqanda/ngenkukhukazi emjikelezweni wamasonto angu-52 sasingu-195.9, 153.7, 125.5 no-138.9 ngokulandelana; ubudala beqanda lokuqala babuyizinsuku ezingu-138.5, 139.0, 134.5 no-129.0 kusukela ekuchanyuselweni, kungekho mehluko obalulekile ngokwezibalo wobudala beqanda lokuqala phakathi kwezinhlobo. Lokhu kuyisimo sokuhlolwa kwezinhlobo ezinakekelwa ngohlelo olulawulwayo, hhayi isivuno sezinkukhukazi ezizifunela ukudla e-KZN. Fanisa ukondla nezindawo zokugcina izinkukhu ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isilinganiso sokuqhathanisa.
rows.st: Teko ya ARC Irene e bapisitse Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo le Naked Neck tlasa dijo tsa kgwebo, metsi le mabone a laolwang. Karolelano ya mahe/kgogo e tshehadi potolohong ya dibeke tse 52 e ne e le 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 le 138.9 ka tatellano; dilemo tsa lehe la pele e ne e le matsatsi a 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 le 129.0 ho tloha ho qhotswa, ho se na phapang ya bohlokwa ka dipalopalo ya dilemo tsa lehe la pele pakeng tsa mefuta. Ena ke moelelo wa mefuta e laolwang, eseng chai ya dikgogo tse itsomelang dijo KZN. Nyalanya phepo le bodulo pele o sebedisa tekanyetso ya papiso.
rows.ts: Ndzavisiso wa ARC Irene wu fananisile Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo na Naked Neck ti ri ni swakudya swa mabindzu, mati ni ku voninga loku lawuriwaka. Avhareji ya matandza/huku ya xisati eka ndzhendzheleko wa mavhiki ya 52 a yi ri 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 na 138.9 hi ku landzelelana; vukhale bya tandza ro sungula a byi ri masiku ya 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 na 129.0 ku suka eka ku tlhotlhoriwa, ku nga ri na ku hambana ka nkoka hi tinhlayohlayo ka vukhale bya tandza ro sungula eka tinxaka. Lawa i swiyimo swa tinxaka leti lawuriwaka, ku nga ri ntshovelo wa tihuku leti tilavelaka swakudya eKZN. Fananisa ku phamela ni tindlu u nga si tirhisa mpimo wo fananisa.
rows.ve: Mulingo wa ARC Irene wo vhambedza Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo na Naked Neck dzi na zwiḽiwa zwa mabindu, maḓi na tshedza tshi langwaho. Avhareji ya makumba/nga khuhu ya tshisadzi kha mutevhe wa vhege dza 52 yo vha i 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 na 138.9 nga u tevhekana; miṅwaha ya gumba ḽa u thoma yo vha i maḓuvha a 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 na 129.0 u bva kha u thothonya, hu si na phambano ya ndeme nga mbalombalo ya miṅwaha ya gumba ḽa u thoma vhukati ha tshaka. Aya ndi mafhungo a tshaka dzi langwaho, hu si khaṋo ya khuhu dzi ḓilavelaho zwiḽiwa ngei KZN. Vhambedzani u fha zwiḽiwa na vhudzulo phanḓa ha u shumisa tshikombo tsha u vhambedza.

rows.english: Commercial layer reference: bird age from hatch, not weeks after buying point-of-lay pullets or building housing. Supplier strain, rearing and actual onset can differ. The former 16–17 week figure was the SAPA receiving/housing age, not evidence of first eggs.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sezinkukhukazi zamaqanda zokuhweba: ubudala benkukhu kusukela ekuchanyuselweni, hhayi amasonto ngemva kokuthenga izinkukhukazi ezisondela ekuqaleni kokubekela noma ukwakha indawo yazo. Uhlobo lomphakeli, ukukhuliswa nokuqala kwangempela kungahluka. Inani langaphambilini lamasonto angu-16–17 laliwubudala bokwamukela/ukufaka endlini be-SAPA, hhayi ubufakazi bamaqanda okuqala.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya dikgogo tsa mahe tsa kgwebo: dilemo tsa kgogo ho tloha ho qhotswa, eseng dibeke ka mora ho reka dikgogo tse tshehadi tse haufi le ho behela kapa ho haha bodulo. Mofuta wa mofani, kgodiso le nako ya nnete ya ho qala di ka fapana. Palo ya pele ya dibeke tse 16–17 e ne e le dilemo tsa SAPA tsa ho amohela/ho kenya ka tlung, eseng bopaki ba mahe a pele.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa tihuku ta matandza ta mabindzu: vukhale bya huku ku suka eka ku tlhotlhoriwa, ku nga ri mavhiki endzhaku ka ku xava tihuku ta xisati leti nga kusuhi ni ku sungula ku tshikela kumbe ku aka tindlu. Muxaka wa muphakeri, ku kurisiwa ni ku sungula ka xiviri swi nga hambana. Nhlayo ya khale ya mavhiki ya 16–17 a yi ri vukhale bya SAPA bya ku amukela/ku nghenisa etindlwini, ku nga ri vumbhoni bya matandza yo sungula.
rows.ve: Tshikombo tsha khuhu dza makumba dza mabindu: miṅwaha ya khuhu u bva kha u thothonya, hu si vhege nga murahu ha u renga khuhu dza tshisadzi dzi re tsini na u thoma u kudzela kana u fhaṱa vhudzulo. Lushaka lwa murengisi, u alusiwa na tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tsha u thoma zwi nga fhambana. Mbalo ya kale ya vhege dza 16–17 yo vha i miṅwaha ya SAPA ya u ṱanganedza/u dzhenisa nḓuni, hu si vhuṱanzi ha makumba a u thoma.

rows.english: Table 4a's cumulative 'Eggs/hen housed' for five commercial strains; the same table gives 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' for every strain. Commercial barn/cage average, not a free-range smallholder trial. Kept as the source gives it: a per-year rate would need a point-of-lay age from another document.
rows.zu: Ithebula 4a linikeza isamba esiqoqekayo se-'Eggs/hen housed' sezinhlobo ezinhlanu zokuhweba; ithebula elifanayo linikeza 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' kuhlobo ngalunye. Isilinganiso sezindlu/amakheji zokuhweba, hhayi ukuhlolwa komlimi omncane wezinkukhu ezihamba ngaphandle. Kugcinwa njengoba umthombo ukunikeza: inani langonyaka lingadinga ubudala bokusondela ekuqaleni kokubekela obuvela komunye umbhalo.
rows.st: Tafole 4a e fana ka kakaretso e bokellaneng ya 'Eggs/hen housed' bakeng sa mefuta e mehlano ya kgwebo; tafole e tshwanang e fana ka 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' bakeng sa mofuta ka mong. Ke karolelano ya matlo/masaka a dikgogo tsa kgwebo, eseng teko ya morui e monyane ya dikgogo tse tsamayang kantle. E bolokilwe jwalokaha mohlodi o e fana: palo ya selemo e ka hloka dilemo tsa ho ba haufi le ho behela tse tswang tokomaneng e nngwe.
rows.ts: Tafula 4a ri nyika nhlayo leyi hlengeletaneke ya 'Eggs/hen housed' eka tinxaka ta ntlhanu ta mabindzu; tafula rin'we ri nyika 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' eka muxaka wun'wana ni wun'wana. I avhareji ya tindlu/tikheji ta mabindzu, ku nga ri ndzavisiso wa murimi lontsongo wa tihuku leti fambafambaka ehandle. Swi hlayisiwa hi ndlela leyi xihlovo xi swi nyikaka ha yona: mpimo wa lembe wu ta lava vukhale bya ku va kusuhi ni ku sungula ku tshikela ku suka eka tsalwa rin'wana.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 4a ḽi ṋea ṱhanganyelo yo kuvhanganywaho ya 'Eggs/hen housed' kha tshaka ṱhanu dza mabindu; thebuḽa ḽithihi ḽi ṋea 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' kha lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe. Ndi avhareji ya nnḓu/mabogisi a khuhu dza mabindu, hu si mulingo wa mufuwi muṱuku wa khuhu dzi tshimbilaho nnḓa. Zwi vhulungwa nga nḓila ine tshiko tsha zwi ṋea ngayo: mpimo wa ṅwaha u ḓo ṱoḓa miṅwaha ya u vha tsini na u thoma u kudzela i bvaho kha ḽiṅwe ḽiṅwalwa.

rows.english: Source states water intake is twice the WEIGHT of feed consumed, and gives water as approximately 220 ml/day. Feed weight = 220 ml (treated as 220 g, water density) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. Cross-check: SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Table 4a (p.39) gives cumulative 'Feed intake kg' of 53.5-58.1 kg per hen over the ~73-74 week laying period (511-518 days): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day to 58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, i.e. approximately 0.105-0.112 kg/day - consistent with the 0.11 kg/day figure used here. Commercial system, South Africa.
rows.zu: Umthombo uthi amanzi aphuzwayo aphindwe kabili ISISINDO sokudla okudliwe, futhi unikeza amanzi acishe abe ngu-220 ml/day. Isisindo sokudla = 220 ml (kubhekwa njengo-220 g ngenxa yobuningi bamanzi) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. Ukuqhathanisa: i-SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Ithebula 4a (ikhasi 39) linikeza 'Feed intake kg' eqoqekayo engu-53.5-58.1 kg ngenkukhukazi esikhathini sokubekela esicishe sibe amasonto angu-73-74 (izinsuku ezingu-511-518): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day kuya ku-58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, okusho cishe 0.105-0.112 kg/day - okuhambisana nenani elingu-0.11 kg/day elisetshenziswa lapha. Uhlelo lokuhweba, eNingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Mohlodi o re metsi a nowang a mena habedi BOIMA ba dijo tse jelweng, mme o fana ka metsi a ka bang 220 ml/day. Boima ba dijo = 220 ml (e nkwang e le 220 g ka lebaka la teteano ya metsi) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. Ho hlahloba hape: SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Tafole 4a (leq.39) e fana ka kakaretso ya 'Feed intake kg' ya 53.5-58.1 kg ka kgogo e tshehadi nakong ya ho behela ya dibeke tse ka bang 73-74 (matsatsi a 511-518): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day ho isa ho 58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, ke hore hoo e ka bang 0.105-0.112 kg/day - e tsamaellanang le palo ya 0.11 kg/day e sebediswang mona. Mokgwa wa kgwebo, Afrika Borwa.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xi vula leswaku mati lama nwiwaka ma andzisa kambirhi NTIKELO wa swakudya leswi dyiweke, naswona xi nyika mati ya kwalomu ka 220 ml/day. Ntikelo wa swakudya = 220 ml (yi tekiwa yi ri 220 g hi ku ya hi ntlimbano wa mati) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. Ku tlhela ku kambisisiwa: SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Tafula 4a (tl.39) ri nyika nhlayo leyi hlengeletaneke ya 'Feed intake kg' ya 53.5-58.1 kg hi huku ya xisati eka nkarhi wa ku tshikela wa kwalomu ka mavhiki ya 73-74 (masiku ya 511-518): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day ku ya eka 58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, hi leswaku kwalomu ka 0.105-0.112 kg/day - leswi fambelanaka ni nhlayo ya 0.11 kg/day leyi tirhisiwaka laha. Mafambiselo ya mabindzu, Afrika-Dzonga.
rows.ve: Tshiko tshi ri maḓi ane a nwiwa a ita kavhili TSHILEME tsha zwiḽiwa zwo ḽiwaho, nahone tshi ṋea maḓi a ṱoḓaho u vha 220 ml/day. Tshileme tsha zwiḽiwa = 220 ml (zwi tshi dzhiiwa sa 220 g u ya nga u tsitsikana ha maḓi) / 2 = 110 g/day = 0.11 kg/day. U dovha u sedzulusa: SAPA Industry Profile 2022 Thebuḽa 4a (siaṱ.39) ḽi ṋea ṱhanganyelo ya 'Feed intake kg' ya 53.5-58.1 kg nga khuhu ya tshisadzi kha tshifhinga tsha u kudzela tsha vhege dzi ṱoḓaho u vha 73-74 (maḓuvha a 511-518): 53500/511 = 104.7 g/day u ya kha 58100/518 = 112.2 g/day, zwine zwa amba u ṱoḓa u vha 0.105-0.112 kg/day - zwi anḓanaho na mbalo ya 0.11 kg/day i shumiswaho afha. Maitele a mabindu, Afrika Tshipembe.

rows.english: Indoor/house floor space in a Free Range or Barn system with perches: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. The same Code's external range limit is much larger (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird outdoors, see welfare) - not mixed into this indoor figure, per the instruction not to combine different systems. A separate cage-system table in the same document (Table 3.1) gives a different, more confined figure for battery cages, also not used here since this enterprise is framed as free-range/barn. South Africa.
rows.zu: Indawo yaphansi yangaphakathi/endlini ohlelweni lwe-Free Range noma lwe-Barn olunezindawo zokuhlala kwezinkukhu: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. Umkhawulo wangaphandle weKhodi efanayo unendawo enkulu kakhulu (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird ngaphandle, bheka ukunakekelwa) - awuxutshwa kuleli nani langaphakathi, ngokomyalo wokungahlanganisi izinhlelo ezihlukene. Elinye ithebula lohlelo lwamakheji kumbhalo ofanayo (Ithebula 3.1) linikeza inani elihlukile elinendawo encane kakhulu kumakheji alandelanayo, nalo alisetshenziswa lapha ngoba lolu hlobo lokufuya luchazwa njenge-free-range/barn. INingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Sebaka sa fatshe ka hare/ka tlung mokgweng wa Free Range kapa Barn o nang le moo dikgogo di dulang teng: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. Moedi wa sebaka sa kantle sa Khoutu e tshwanang o moholo haholo (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird kantle, sheba tlhokomelo) - ha o kopantswe le palo ena ya ka hare, ho ya ka taelo ya ho se kopanye mekgwa e fapaneng. Tafole e nngwe ya mokgwa wa masaka a dikgogo tokomaneng e tshwanang (Tafole 3.1) e fana ka palo e fapaneng e nang le sebaka se senyane ho feta bakeng sa masaka a kgobokantsweng, le yona ha e sebediswe mona hobane kgwebo ena e hlaloswa e le free-range/barn. Afrika Borwa.
rows.ts: Ndhawu ya le hansi endzeni/endlwini eka mafambiselo ya Free Range kumbe Barn lama nga ni tindhawu to tshamela tihuku: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. Ndhawu ya le handle leyi pimiweke hi Khodi yin'we yi tele ngopfu (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird ehandle, vona nhlayiso) - a yi hlanganisiwi ni nhlayo leyi ya le ndzeni, hi ku ya hi xileriso xo ka ku nga hlanganisiwi mafambiselo lama hambaneke. Tafula rin'wana ra mafambiselo ya tikheji eka tsalwa rin'we (Tafula 3.1) ri nyika nhlayo yin'wana ya ndhawu leyi pfaleriweke swinene ya tikheji leti hlanganisiweke, na yona a yi tirhisiwi laha hikuva bindzu leri ri hlamuseriwa ri ri free-range/barn. Afrika-Dzonga.
rows.ve: Tshikhala tsha fhasi tsha nḓuni kha maitele a Free Range kana Barn a re na fhethu ha u dzula ha khuhu: 12 birds/m2 = 1/12 = 0.083 m2/bird. Mukhano wa fhethu ha nnḓa wa Khoudi yeneyo u ṋea tshikhala tshihulwane nga maanḓa (5 birds/m2 = 0.2 m2/bird nnḓa, sedzani ndondolo) - a u ṱanganyiswi na mbalo iyi ya nḓuni, u ya nga ndaela ya u sa ṱanganyisa maitele o fhambanaho. Ḽiṅwe thebuḽa ḽa maitele a mabogisi a u dzudza khuhu kha ḽiṅwalwa ḽithihi (Thebuḽa 3.1) ḽi ṋea mbalo yo fhambanaho ya tshikhala tsho tsitsikanaho nga maanḓa kha mabogisi o kuvhanganywaho, na yone a i shumiswi afha ngauri bindu iḽi ḽi ṱaluswa sa free-range/barn. Afrika Tshipembe.

rows.english: SAPA 2024 commercial strain standards cumulative to 90 weeks: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 and Lohmann Brown Lite 413. These are full-cycle objectives, not eggs per calendar year or a smallholder forecast. Purchase age, actual onset of lay, surviving laying hens, feed, water and lighting need separate records.
rows.zu: Amazinga ezinhlobo zokuhweba e-SAPA 2024 ayisamba kuze kube amasonto angu-90: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 ne-Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Lezi yizinhloso zomjikelezo ogcwele, hhayi amaqanda ngonyaka wekhalenda noma isibikezelo somlimi omncane. Ubudala bokuthengwa, ukuqala kwangempela kokubekela, izinkukhukazi ezibekelayo ezisaphila, ukudla, amanzi nokukhanyisa kudinga amarekhodi ahlukile.
rows.st: Maemo a mefuta ya kgwebo ya SAPA 2024 a bokellaneng ho fihlela dibeke tse 90: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 le Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Tsena ke dipheo tsa potoloho e felletseng, eseng mahe ka selemo sa khalendara kapa ponelopele ya morui e monyane. Dilemo ha ho rekwa, nako ya nnete ya ho qala ho behela, dikgogo tse tshehadi tse behelang tse ntseng di phela, dijo, metsi le mabone di hloka direkoto tse arohaneng.
rows.ts: Swipimelo swa tinxaka ta mabindzu swa SAPA 2024 leswi hlengeletanekeke ku fika eka mavhiki ya 90: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 na Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Leyi i mimpakanyo ya ndzhendzheleko lowu heleleke, ku nga ri matandza hi lembe ra khalendara kumbe mvhumbo wa murimi lontsongo. Vukhale loko ti xaviwa, ku sungula ka xiviri ko tshikela, tihuku ta xisati leti tshikelaka leti hanyeke, swakudya, mati ni ku voninga swi lava tirhekhodo leti hambaneke.
rows.ve: Zwipimo zwa tshaka dza mabindu zwa SAPA 2024 zwo kuvhanganywaho u swika kha vhege dza 90: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 na Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Hezwi ndi zwipikwa zwa mutevhe wo fhelelaho, hu si makumba nga ṅwaha wa khalenda kana mbonelaphanḓa ya mufuwi muṱuku. Miṅwaha musi hu tshi rengwa, tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tsha u thoma u kudzela, khuhu dza tshisadzi dzi kudzelaho dzo tshilaho, zwiḽiwa, maḓi na tshedza zwi ṱoḓa rekhodo dzo fhambanaho.

rows.english: P44 = Pekin (7 weeks to slaughter); MR71 = Muscovy (10 weeks for ducks/hens, 12 weeks for drakes). Treated as 'time to first product' = age to slaughter, since this is a single-cycle meat enterprise (no repeat product like eggs). Non-South-African trial by Warsaw researchers, published in SAJAS; journal location does not establish local applicability.
rows.zu: P44 = Pekin (amasonto angu-7 kuze kuhlatshwe); MR71 = Muscovy (amasonto angu-10 kumadada ezinsikazi, angu-12 kwabesilisa). Kubhekwa 'njengesikhathi somkhiqizo wokuqala' = ubudala bokuhlatshwa, ngoba lolu hlobo lokufuya inyama lunomjikelezo owodwa (alunawo umkhiqizo ophindaphindayo njengamaqanda). Ukuhlolwa okungesikho kwaseNingizimu Afrika okwenziwa ngabacwaningi baseWarsaw, kwashicilelwa ku-SAJAS; indawo yejenali ayiqinisekisi ukufaneleka kwendawo.
rows.st: P44 = Pekin (dibeke tse 7 ho fihlela ho hlajwa); MR71 = Muscovy (dibeke tse 10 bakeng sa matata a tshehadi, tse 12 bakeng sa a tona). E nkuwa e le 'nako ya sehlahiswa sa pele' = dilemo tsa ho hlajwa, hobane ena ke kgwebo ya nama ya potoloho e le nngwe (ha ho sehlahiswa se phetwang jwaloka mahe). Ke teko e seng ya Afrika Borwa ya bafuputsi ba Warsaw, e phatlaladitsweng ho SAJAS; sebaka sa jenale ha se tiise hore e loketse sebaka sa heno.
rows.ts: P44 = Pekin (mavhiki ya 7 ku fika eku tlhaviweni); MR71 = Muscovy (mavhiki ya 10 eka masekwa ya xisati, ya 12 eka ya xinuna). Swi tekiwa swi ri 'nkarhi wa xibveledzwa xo sungula' = vukhale loko ku tlhaviwa, hikuva leri i bindzu ra nyama ra ndzhendzheleko wun'we (a ri na xibveledzwa lexi vuyeleriwaka ku fana ni matandza). I ndzavisiso lowu nga riki wa Afrika-Dzonga wa valavisisi va Warsaw, lowu kandziyisiweke eka SAJAS; ndhawu ya jenali a yi tiyisisi leswaku wu tirha endhawini.
rows.ve: P44 = Pekin (vhege dza 7 u swika kha u ṱhavha); MR71 = Muscovy (vhege dza 10 kha masekwa a tshisadzi, dza 12 kha a tshinna). Zwi dzhiiwa sa 'tshifhinga tsha tshibveledzwa tsha u thoma' = miṅwaha ya u ṱhavhiwa, ngauri iḽi ndi bindu ḽa ṋama ḽa mutevhe muthihi (a ḽi na tshibveledzwa tshi dovhololaho u fana na makumba). Ndi mulingo u si wa Afrika Tshipembe wa vhaṱoḓisisi vha Warsaw, wo anḓadzwaho kha SAJAS; fhethu ha dzhenala a hu khwaṱhisedzi uri zwi a shuma henefho.

rows.english: Non-SA (Guyana study reporting a citation to Steklenev 1990); no SA-specific absolute slaughter live-weight figure was found (see gaps). 2.93 kg = Pekin at 8-10 weeks, 2.29 kg = Muscovy at 8-10 weeks - matches this enterprise's two breeds. The same LRRD paper's own experiment (Table 2, intensive system, Guyana) measured live weight at slaughter (8 weeks) as: Pekin drakes 2.53 kg, Pekin hens 2.29 kg, Muscovy drakes 2.47 kg, Muscovy hens 1.51 kg - broadly consistent with, but not merged into, the cited range above since it is a separate dataset/table in the same source. No sourced eggs/duck/year figure was found for either breed (see gaps); the LRRD and SAJAS sources used here studied ducks reared only for meat.
rows.zu: Akusikho kwaseNingizimu Afrika (ucwaningo lwaseGuyana olubika ukucaphuna u-Steklenev 1990); alitholakalanga inani eliqondile lesisindo sokuhlatshwa esiphilayo eliqondene neNingizimu Afrika (bheka okushodayo). 2.93 kg = Pekin enamasonto angu-8-10, 2.29 kg = Muscovy enamasonto angu-8-10 - kuhambisana nezinhlobo ezimbili zalolu hlobo lokufuya. Ukuhlolwa kwephepha elifanayo le-LRRD uqobo (Ithebula 2, uhlelo olunakekelwa kakhulu, eGuyana) kwakala isisindo esiphilayo sokuhlatshwa (emasontweni angu-8) kanje: Pekin abesilisa 2.53 kg, Pekin izinsikazi 2.29 kg, Muscovy abesilisa 2.47 kg, Muscovy izinsikazi 1.51 kg - okuhambisana ngokubanzi nobubanzi obucashunwe ngenhla, kodwa okungahlanganiswa nabo ngoba kuyidatha/ithebula elehlukile emthonjeni ofanayo. Alitholakalanga inani elinomthombo lamaqanda/ngedada/ngonyaka kunoma yiluphi uhlobo (bheka okushodayo); imithombo ye-LRRD ne-SAJAS esetshenziswa lapha yacwaninga amadada akhuliselwa inyama kuphela.
rows.st: Ha se ya Afrika Borwa (phuputso ya Guyana e tlalehang qotso ya Steklenev 1990); ha ho palo e tobileng ya boima bo phelang ba ho hlajwa ya Afrika Borwa e fumanweng (sheba dikgeo). 2.93 kg = Pekin dibekeng tse 8-10, 2.29 kg = Muscovy dibekeng tse 8-10 - e tsamaellana le mefuta e mmedi ya kgwebo ena. Teko ya pampiri e tshwanang ya LRRD ka boyona (Tafole 2, mokgwa o matla wa tlhokomelo, Guyana) e lekantse boima bo phelang ha ho hlajwa (dibeke tse 8) e le: Pekin tse tona 2.53 kg, Pekin tse tshehadi 2.29 kg, Muscovy tse tona 2.47 kg, Muscovy tse tshehadi 1.51 kg - e tsamaellanang ka kakaretso le moedi o qotsitsweng ka hodimo, empa e sa kopanngwe le wona hobane ke dintlha/tafole e fapaneng mohloding o tshwanang. Ha ho palo e nang le mohlodi ya mahe/letata/selemo e fumanweng bakeng sa mofuta ofe kapa ofe (sheba dikgeo); mehlodi ya LRRD le SAJAS e sebediswang mona e ithutile matata a ruilweng bakeng sa nama feela.
rows.ts: A hi ya Afrika-Dzonga (ndzavisiso wa Guyana lowu vikaka ku tshahiwa ka Steklenev 1990); a ku kumekanga nhlayo ya xiviri ya ntikelo lowu hanyaka loko ku tlhaviwa leyi kongomaka Afrika-Dzonga (vona leswi kayivelaka). 2.93 kg = Pekin eka mavhiki ya 8-10, 2.29 kg = Muscovy eka mavhiki ya 8-10 - swi fambelana ni tinxaka timbirhi ta bindzu leri. Ndzavisiso wa phepha rin'we ra LRRD hi roxe (Tafula 2, mafambiselo ya nhlayiso lowukulu, Guyana) wu pimile ntikelo lowu hanyaka loko ku tlhaviwa (mavhiki ya 8) wu ri: Pekin ta xinuna 2.53 kg, Pekin ta xisati 2.29 kg, Muscovy ta xinuna 2.47 kg, Muscovy ta xisati 1.51 kg - swi fambelanaka hi ku angarhela ni mpimo lowu tshahiweke laha henhla, kambe swi nga hlanganisiwi na wona hikuva i vuxokoxoko/tafula rin'wana eka xihlovo xin'we. A ku kumekanga nhlayo leyi nga ni xihlovo ya matandza/sekwa/lembe ya muxaka wun'wana ni wun'wana (vona leswi kayivelaka); swihlovo swa LRRD ni SAJAS leswi tirhisiwaka laha swi dyondze hi masekwa lama kuriseriwaka nyama ntsena.
rows.ve: A si zwa Afrika Tshipembe (ṱhoḓisiso ya Guyana i vhigaho u redzwa ha Steklenev 1990); a hu na mbalo ya vhukuma ya tshileme tshi tshilaho musi hu tshi ṱhavhiwa ya Afrika Tshipembe yo wanalaho (sedzani zwi ṱahelaho). 2.93 kg = Pekin kha vhege dza 8-10, 2.29 kg = Muscovy kha vhege dza 8-10 - zwi fana na tshaka mbili dza bindu iḽi. Mulingo wa bammbiri ḽithihi ḽa LRRD ḽone ḽiṋe (Thebuḽa 2, maitele a ndondolo yo khwaṱhaho, Guyana) wo kala tshileme tshi tshilaho musi hu tshi ṱhavhiwa (vhege dza 8) sa: Pekin dza tshinna 2.53 kg, Pekin dza tshisadzi 2.29 kg, Muscovy dza tshinna 2.47 kg, Muscovy dza tshisadzi 1.51 kg - zwi anḓanaho nga u angaredza na mikhano yo redzwaho afho nṱha, fhedzi zwi songo ṱanganyiswa nayo ngauri ndi mafhungo/thebuḽa ḽo fhambanaho kha tshiko tshithihi. A hu na mbalo i re na tshiko ya makumba/sekwa/ṅwaha yo wanalaho kha lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe (sedzani zwi ṱahelaho); zwiko zwa LRRD na SAJAS zwi shumiswaho afha zwo ita ṱhoḓisiso ya masekwa o aluselwaho ṋama fhedzi.

rows.english: 0.08 bird/m2 (outdoor/free-range system) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - used here as the primary figure since smallholder/backyard duck-keeping is closer to this free-range system than to intensive deep-litter housing. The same source's INTENSIVE deep-litter system gives 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (a very different, much more confined figure) - noted here for context but NOT merged into the range above, per the instruction not to mix figures from different systems. Non-South-African trial by Warsaw researchers, published in SAJAS; journal location does not establish local applicability.
rows.zu: 0.08 bird/m2 (uhlelo lwangaphandle/lokuzihambela) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - kusetshenziswa lapha njengenani eliyinhloko ngoba ukufuya amadada kwabalimi abancane/emagcekeni kusondelene nalolu hlelo lokuzihambela kunokugcinwa endlini okunakekelwa kakhulu okunongqimba olujulile lwezinto zokwendlala. Uhlelo lomthombo ofanayo LOKUNAKEKELA KAKHULU olunongqimba olujulile lwezinto zokwendlala lunikeza 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (inani elihluke kakhulu elinendawo encane kakhulu) - kubhalwe lapha ukunikeza umongo kodwa AKUHLANGANISWA nobubanzi obungenhla, ngokomyalo wokungaxutshi izibalo zezinhlelo ezihlukene. Ukuhlolwa okungesikho kwaseNingizimu Afrika okwenziwa ngabacwaningi baseWarsaw, kwashicilelwa ku-SAJAS; indawo yejenali ayiqinisekisi ukufaneleka kwendawo.
rows.st: 0.08 bird/m2 (mokgwa wa kantle/ho tsamaya ka bolokolohi) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - e sebediswa mona e le palo e ka sehloohong hobane ho rua matata ha barui ba banyane/ka jareteng ho haufi le mokgwa ona wa ho tsamaya ka bolokolohi ho feta wa ka tlung o hlokomelwang haholo o nang le moalo o teteaneng. Mokgwa wa mohlodi o tshwanang wa TLHOKOMELO E MATLA o nang le moalo o teteaneng o fana ka 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (palo e fapaneng haholo, e nang le sebaka se senyane haholo) - e boletswe mona bakeng sa moelelo empa HA E KOPANTSWE le moedi o ka hodimo, ho ya ka taelo ya ho se kopanye dipalo tsa mekgwa e fapaneng. Ke teko e seng ya Afrika Borwa ya bafuputsi ba Warsaw, e phatlaladitsweng ho SAJAS; sebaka sa jenale ha se tiise hore e loketse sebaka sa heno.
rows.ts: 0.08 bird/m2 (mafambiselo ya le handle/ku fambafamba hi ku ntshunxeka) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - yi tirhisiwa laha yi ri nhlayo leyikulu hikuva ku fuwa masekwa ka varimi lavatsongo/ka le ndzhaku ka muti ku le kusuhi ni mafambiselo lawa yo fambafamba hi ku ntshunxeka ku hundza nhlayiso lowukulu wa le ndlwini lowu nga ni byetlelo byo enta. Mafambiselo ya NHLAYISO LOWUKULU lama nga ni byetlelo byo enta eka xihlovo xin'we ma nyika 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (nhlayo leyi hambaneke swinene, leyi nga ni ndhawu yitsongo swinene) - swi boxiwa laha ku nyika mongo kambe A SWI HLANGANISIWI ni mpimo lowu nga laha henhla, hi ku ya hi xileriso xo ka ku nga hlanganisiwi tinhlayo ta mafambiselo lama hambaneke. I ndzavisiso lowu nga riki wa Afrika-Dzonga wa valavisisi va Warsaw, lowu kandziyisiweke eka SAJAS; ndhawu ya jenali a yi tiyisisi leswaku wu tirha endhawini.
rows.ve: 0.08 bird/m2 (maitele a nnḓa/u tshimbila nga vhuḓilangi) = 1/0.08 = 12.5 m2/bird - zwi shumiswa afha sa mbalo khulwane ngauri u fuwa masekwa ha vhafuwi vhaṱuku/muṱani hu tsini na maitele aya a u tshimbila nga vhuḓilangi u fhira ndondolo yo khwaṱhaho ya nḓuni i re na zwiandadzwa zwo tsitsikanaho. Maitele a NDONDOLO YO KHWAṰHAHO a tshiko tshithihi a re na zwiandadzwa zwo tsitsikanaho a ṋea 2.9 bird/m2 = 1/2.9 = 0.34 m2/bird (mbalo yo fhambanaho vhukuma, ya tshikhala tshiṱuku nga maanḓa) - zwo bulwa afha u itela mafhungo a u pfesesa fhedzi A ZWI ṰANGANYISWI na mikhano i re afho nṱha, u ya nga ndaela ya u sa ṱanganyisa mbalo dza maitele o fhambanaho. Ndi mulingo u si wa Afrika Tshipembe wa vhaṱoḓisisi vha Warsaw, wo anḓadzwaho kha SAJAS; fhethu ha dzhenala a hu khwaṱhisedzi uri zwi a shuma henefho.

rows.english: 10 months x 4.35 = 43.5 weeks; 12 months x 4.35 = 52.2 weeks. This is Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) grow-out time to harvestable size; the source separately states Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) reaches harvestable maturity faster, in 6-10 months (= 26.1-43.5 weeks) — not used here as it is a different species with a different legal status (see 'legal').
rows.zu: Izinyanga ezingu-10 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-43.5; izinyanga ezingu-12 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-52.2. Lesi yisikhathi sokukhulisa i-Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) kuze ibe ngosayizi ovunekayo; umthombo usho ngokwehlukana ukuthi i-Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) ifinyelela ekuvuthweni okuvunwayo ngokushesha, ngezinyanga ezingu-6-10 (= amasonto angu-26.1-43.5) — akusetshenziswa lapha ngoba iyinhlobo ehlukile enesimo somthetho esihlukile (bheka 'umthetho').
rows.st: Dikgwedi tse 10 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 43.5; dikgwedi tse 12 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 52.2. Ena ke nako ya kgodiso ya Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) ho fihlela boholo bo ka kotulwang; mohlodi o bolela ka thoko hore Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) e fihla ho butsweng ho ka kotulwang kapele, ka dikgwedi tse 6-10 (= dibeke tse 26.1-43.5) — ha e sebediswe mona hobane ke mofuta o fapaneng o nang le boemo bo fapaneng ba molao (sheba 'molao').
rows.ts: Tin'hweti ta 10 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 43.5; tin'hweti ta 12 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 52.2. Lowu i nkarhi wa ku kurisa Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) ku fika eka vukulu byo tshovela; xihlovo xi vula hi ku hambana leswaku Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) yi fika eka ku kula ko tshoveriwa hi ku hatlisa, eka tin'hweti ta 6-10 (= mavhiki ya 26.1-43.5) — a swi tirhisiwi laha hikuva i muxaka lowu hambaneke lowu nga ni xiyimo xa nawu lexi hambaneke (vona 'nawu').
rows.ve: Miṅwedzi ya 10 x 4.35 = vhege dza 43.5; miṅwedzi ya 12 x 4.35 = vhege dza 52.2. Hetshi ndi tshifhinga tsha u alusa Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) u swika kha vhuhulwane ha u kaṋiwa; tshiko tshi bula nga thungo uri Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) i swika kha vhuhulwane ha u kaṋiwa nga u ṱavhanya, kha miṅwedzi ya 6-10 (= vhege dza 26.1-43.5) — a zwi shumiswi afha ngauri ndi lushaka lwo fhambanaho lu re na vhuimo ha mulayo ho fhambanaho (sedzani 'mulayo').

rows.english: Table 8-3 gives the Mozambique Tilapia's harvestable size as an approximate single figure ('+- 800g'), not a range, so [800, 800] is used rather than inventing a spread. The same table cell wraps '10-12' across a line break in the PDF ('10-\n12'), kept verbatim. The table's Nile Tilapia row gives the same approximate weight (+-800g) reached faster, in 6-10 months — not used here because this dossier is framed around the indigenous, legally unrestricted Mozambique Tilapia per task instruction; see 'legal' for why Nile Tilapia is treated separately. No SA source was found giving a feed-conversion-based or per-hectare yield figure specific to O. mossambicus that could be converted to this per-fish unit without stitching numbers across documents, so outputUnit follows the source's own unit (grams harvest weight per fish) rather than being converted.
rows.zu: Ithebula 8-3 linikeza usayizi ovunekayo we-Mozambique Tilapia njengenani elilodwa elilinganiselwayo ('+- 800g'), hhayi ububanzi, ngakho kusetshenziswa [800, 800] kunokuba kusungulwe ukusabalala. Iseli elifanayo lethebula lihlukanisa u-'10-12' ngekhefu lomugqa ku-PDF ('10-\n12'), kugcinwa njengalokho. Umugqa we-Nile Tilapia ethebuleni unikeza isisindo esifanayo esilinganiselwayo (+-800g) esifinyelelwa ngokushesha, ngezinyanga ezingu-6-10 — akusetshenziswa lapha ngoba lo mbhalo ugxile ku-Mozambique Tilapia yendabuko engenamkhawulo womthetho ngokomyalo womsebenzi; bheka 'umthetho' ukuthi kungani i-Nile Tilapia ibhekwa ngokwehlukana. Awutholakalanga umthombo waseNingizimu Afrika onikeza isibalo esiqondene ne-O. mossambicus esisuselwa ekuguqulweni kokudla noma isivuno ngehektha esingaguqulelwa kule yunithi ngenhlanzi ngaphandle kokuthunga izinombolo zemibhalo ehlukene, ngakho i-outputUnit ilandela iyunithi yomthombo uqobo (amagremu esisindo sokuvuna ngenhlanzi) kunokuba iguqulwe.
rows.st: Tafole 8-3 e fana ka boholo bo ka kotulwang ba Mozambique Tilapia e le palo e le nngwe e hakanyeditsweng ('+- 800g'), eseng moedi, kahoo [800, 800] e sebediswa ho ena le ho iqapela pharallo. Sele e tshwanang ya tafole e arola '10-12' ka kgefutso ya mola ho PDF ('10-\n12'), e bolokilwe e le jwalo. Mola wa Nile Tilapia tafoleng o fana ka boima bo tshwanang bo hakanyeditsweng (+-800g) bo fihlelwang kapele, ka dikgwedi tse 6-10 — ha o sebediswe mona hobane dosiye ena e thehilwe ho Mozambique Tilapia ya tlhaho e sa thibelwang ka molao ho ya ka taelo ya mosebetsi; sheba 'molao' bakeng sa lebaka leo Nile Tilapia e tshwarwang ka thoko. Ha ho mohlodi wa Afrika Borwa o fumanweng o fanang ka palo ya phetoho ya dijo kapa chai ka hektare e tobileng O. mossambicus e ka fetolelwang yuniti ena ka tlhapi ntle le ho kopanya dipalo tsa ditokomane tse fapaneng, kahoo outputUnit e latela yuniti ya mohlodi ka boyona (digeramo tsa boima ha ho kotulwa ka tlhapi) ho ena le ho fetolwa.
rows.ts: Tafula 8-3 ri nyika vukulu byo tshovela bya Mozambique Tilapia byi ri nhlayo yin'we ya mpimanyeto ('+- 800g'), ku nga ri mpimo wo suka laha ku ya hala, hikokwalaho ku tirhisiwa [800, 800] ematshan'wini yo tumbuluxa ku hambana. Xibokisana xin'we xa tafula xi avanyisa '10-12' hi ku tshoveka ka layini eka PDF ('10-\n12'), leswi hlayisiweke hi ku kongoma. Layini ya Nile Tilapia eka tafula yi nyika ntikelo wun'we wa mpimanyeto (+-800g) lowu fikeleriwaka hi ku hatlisa, eka tin'hweti ta 6-10 — a wu tirhisiwi laha hikuva dosiyere leyi yi kongomisa eka Mozambique Tilapia ya ndhavuko leyi nga riki ni xipimelo xa nawu hi ku ya hi xileriso xa ntirho; vona 'nawu' ku tiva leswaku hikokwalaho ka yini Nile Tilapia yi tekiwa hi ku hambana. A ku kumekanga xihlovo xa Afrika-Dzonga lexi nyikaka nhlayo leyi sekeriweke eka ku hundzuluka ka swakudya kumbe ntshovelo hi hektara leyi kongomaka eka O. mossambicus leyi nga hundzuriwaka yi va yuniti leyi hi nhlampfi handle ko hlanganisa tinhlayo ta matsalwa, hikokwalaho outputUnit yi landzela yuniti ya xihlovo hi xoxe (tigiramu ta ntikelo wo tshovela hi nhlampfi) ematshan'wini yo hundzuriwa.
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 8-3 ḽi ṋea vhuhulwane ha u kaṋiwa ha Mozambique Tilapia sa mbalo nthihi ya nyanganyelo ('+- 800g'), hu si mikhano, ngauralo hu shumiswa [800, 800] nṱhani ha u tou humbulela phambano. Tshipiḓa tshithihi tsha thebuḽa tshi khethekanya '10-12' nga u khethekanywa ha mutalo kha PDF ('10-\n12'), zwe zwa vhulungwa zwo ralo. Mutalo wa Nile Tilapia kha thebuḽa u ṋea tshileme tshithihi tsha nyanganyelo (+-800g) tshi swikiwaho nga u ṱavhanya, kha miṅwedzi ya 6-10 — a u shumiswi afha ngauri dosiye iyi yo livha kha Mozambique Tilapia ya henefha i si na thivhelo ya mulayo u ya nga ndaela ya mushumo; sedzani 'mulayo' u itela uri ndi ngani Nile Tilapia i dzhiiwa nga thungo. A hu na tshiko tsha Afrika Tshipembe tsho wanalaho tshi ṋeaho mbalo yo ḓitikaho nga u shandukiswa ha zwiḽiwa kana khaṋo nga hekithara yo livhaho kha O. mossambicus ine ya nga shandukiswa ya vha yuniti iyi nga khovhe hu sa ṱanganyiswi mbalo dza maṅwalwa o fhambanaho, ngauralo outputUnit i tevhela yuniti ya tshiko tshone tshiṋe (gireme dza tshileme tsha khaṋo nga khovhe) nṱhani ha u shandukiswa.

rows.english: ARC makes tilapia suitability depend on water temperature: summer grow-out can be suitable anywhere in South Africa when water exceeds 20°C; growth is poor below 18°C and winter water below 13°C can kill farmed tilapia. The Highveld reference is a summer crop; tunnels can widen the range. Measure pond water and confirm stocking species and dates. Air climate or a mapped pond does not prove harvest months, fish numbers or food kg.
rows.zu: I-ARC yenza ukufaneleka kwe-tilapia kuncike ekushiseni kwamanzi: ukukhuliswa ehlobo kungafaneleka noma kuphi eNingizimu Afrika lapho amanzi engaphezu kuka-20°C; ukukhula kubi ngaphansi kuka-18°C futhi amanzi asebusika angaphansi kuka-13°C angabulala i-tilapia efuywayo. Isikhombo sase-Highveld siyisilimo sasehlobo; imigudu emboziwe ingandisa ububanzi. Kala amanzi echibi bese uqinisekisa uhlobo lwezinhlanzi olufakwayo nezinsuku. Isimo sezulu somoya noma ichibi elibhalwe ebalazweni akuqinisekisi izinyanga zokuvuna, izibalo zezinhlanzi noma ama-kg okudla.
