rows.st: ARC e etsa hore ho tshwaneleha ha tilapia ho itshetlehe ka mocheso wa metsi: kgodiso ya lehlabula e ka lokela kae kapa kae Afrika Borwa ha metsi a feta 20°C; kgolo e fokola ka tlase ho 18°C mme metsi a mariha a ka tlase ho 13°C a ka bolaya tilapia e ruilweng. Tshupiso ya Highveld ke sejalo sa lehlabula; dithanele di ka atolosa sebaka sa ho kgona ho e rua. Lekanya metsi a letamo mme o netefatse mofuta o kenngwang le matsatsi. Boemo ba lehodimo ba moya kapa letamo le mmapeng ha di pake dikgwedi tsa kotulo, dipalo tsa ditlhapi kapa kg ya dijo.
rows.ts: ARC yi endla leswaku ku fanela ka tilapia ku titshega hi mahiselo ya mati: ku kurisa hi ximumu ku nga fanela kun'wana ni kun'wana eAfrika-Dzonga loko mati ma ri henhla ka 20°C; ku kula ku nga ri kahle ehansi ka 18°C naswona mati ya xixika lama nga ehansi ka 13°C ma nga dlaya tilapia leyi fuyiwaka. Xikombo xa Highveld i xibyariwa xa ximumu; tithanele ti nga anamisela swiyimo leswi nga tirhaka. Pima mati ya tiva kutani u tiyisisa muxaka lowu nghenisiwaka ni masiku. Maxelo ya moya kumbe tiva leri nga emepeni a swi tiyisisi tin'hweti to tshovela, tinhlayo ta tinhlampfi kumbe kg ta swakudya.
rows.ve: ARC i ita uri u tea ha tilapia hu ḓitike nga mufhiso wa maḓi: u alusa tshilimo zwi nga tea huṅwe na huṅwe Afrika Tshipembe musi maḓi a tshi fhira 20°C; u aluwa a hu vhi havhuḓi fhasi ha 18°C nahone maḓi a vhuria a re fhasi ha 13°C a nga vhulaha tilapia i fuwiwaho. Tshikombo tsha Highveld ndi tshiliṅwa tsha tshilimo; thaneḽa dzi nga ṱanḓavhudza mikhano. Kalani maḓi a dzivha ni khwaṱhisedze lushaka lu dzheniswaho na datumu. Mutsho wa muya kana dzivha ḽo swaiwaho kha mapa a zwi khwaṱhisedzi miṅwedzi ya khaṋo, tshivhalo tsha khovhe kana kg ya zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: Lowest (≥7th parity) and highest (3rd parity) group means for milk yield per 305-day standardised lactation in 16,407 analysed South African ARC Saanen lactation records, 1955–2018, mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Original PDF Table 3 labels the last group ≥7th; HTML renders it >7th. Kept in kg, without litres conversion, annualisation or yield-by-age interpolation.
rows.zu: Izilinganiso eziphansi kakhulu (ukuzala kwe-≥7) neziphezulu kakhulu (ukuzala kwesi-3) zamaqembu esivuno sobisi ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza ubisi esilinganiselwe ezinsukwini ezingu-305 kumarekhodi obisi e-ARC Saanen aseNingizimu Afrika angu-16,407 ahlaziywe, 1955–2018, ikakhulukazi imihlambi yokuzalanisa enakekelwa kakhulu/ngokulingene. Ithebula 3 le-PDF yokuqala libiza iqembu lokugcina ngokuthi ≥7th; i-HTML ibhala >7th. Kugcinwa ku-kg, ngaphandle kokuguqulelwa kumalitha, ukubalwa ngokonyaka noma ukuqagela isivuno ngeminyaka ephakathi kwamaphuzu edatha.
rows.st: Dikarolelano tse tlase ka ho fetisisa (tshwalo ya ≥7) le tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa (tshwalo ya 3) tsa dihlopha tsa chai ya lebese ka nako e lekantsweng ya matsatsi a 305 direkotong tsa lebese tsa ARC Saanen tsa Afrika Borwa tse 16,407 tse hlahlobilweng, 1955–2018, boholo e le mehlape ya ho tswadisa e hlokomelwang ka matla/ka matla a mahareng. Tafole 3 ya PDF ya pele e bitsa sehlopha sa ho qetela ≥7th; HTML e hlahisa >7th. E bolokilwe ka kg, ntle le ho fetolela ho dilitara, ho e bala ka selemo kapa ho hakanya chai ka dilemo tse pakeng tsa dintlha tse teng.
rows.ts: Tiavhareji ta mintlawa ta le hansi swinene (ku tswala ka ≥7) ni ta le henhla swinene (ku tswala ka 3) ta masi hi nkarhi wa masi lowu ringanisiweke wa masiku ya 305 eka tirhekhodo ta masi ta ARC Saanen ta Afrika-Dzonga ta 16,407 leti xopaxopiweke, 1955–2018, ngopfu mintlhambi ya ku tswalisa ya nhlayiso lowukulu/wa le xiringan'weni. Tafula 3 ra PDF yo sungula ri fungha ntlawa wo hetelela ≥7th; HTML yi komba >7th. Swi hlayisiwa hi kg, handle ko hundzurulela eka tilitara, ku endla nhlayo ya lembe kumbe ku pimanyeta ntshovelo hi vukhale bya le xikari ka vuxokoxoko.
rows.ve: Avhareji dza zwigwada dza fhasi-fhasi (u beba ha ≥7) na dza nṱhesa (u beba ha 3) dza khaṋo ya mafhi nga tshifhinga tsha mafhi tsho linganyiswaho tsha maḓuvha a 305 kha rekhodo dza mafhi dza ARC Saanen dza Afrika Tshipembe dza 16,407 dzo senguluswaho, 1955–2018, kanzhi miṱambi ya u bebisa ya ndondolo yo khwaṱhaho/ya vhukati. Thebuḽa 3 ḽa PDF ya u thoma ḽi vhidza tshigwada tsha u fhedza ≥7th; HTML i sumbedza >7th. Zwi vhulungwa nga kg, hu si na u shandukiswa u ya kha lithara, u zwi ita mbalo ya ṅwaha kana u anganyela khaṋo nga miṅwaha i re vhukati ha mafhungo o kaliwaho.

rows.english: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at ≥7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide these totals evenly into months.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sama-Saanen aseNingizimu Afrika ngenombolo yomjikelezo wokukhiqiza ubisi, hhayi ubudala ngeminyaka: isisindo sobisi esimaphakathi ngesikhathi esilinganiselwe sezinsuku ezingu-305 sasingu-947.3 kg ekuzaleni kokuqala, 1043.2 kokwesibili, 1073.4 kokwesithathu, 1020.3 kokwesine, 972.8 kokwesihlanu, 901.6 kokwesithupha no-775.4 kokwe-≥7. La maqembu e-ARC anamarekhodi obisi ayeyimihlambi yokuzalanisa enakekelwa kakhulu/ngokulingene ikakhulukazi. Rekhoda usuku lwangempela lokuzala kwamazinyane, inombolo yomjikelezo wobisi nobisi oluqoqiwe; ungahlukanisi lezi zamba ngokulinganayo phakathi kwezinyanga.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya Saanen ya Afrika Borwa ka nomoro ya nako ya tlhahiso ya lebese, eseng dilemo tsa phoofolo: boima ba lebese bo karolelano ka nako e lekantsweng ya matsatsi a 305 e ne e le 947.3 kg tshwalong ya pele, 1043.2 ya bobedi, 1073.4 ya boraro, 1020.3 ya bone, 972.8 ya bohlano, 901.6 ya botshelela le 775.4 ho ya ≥7. Dihlopha tsena tsa ARC tse rekotetsweng lebese boholo e ne e le mehlape ya ho tswadisa e hlokomelwang ka matla/ka matla a mahareng. Rekota letsatsi la nnete la ho tswala madinyane, nomoro ya nako ya lebese le lebese le bokelletsweng; o se ke wa arola dipalo tsena ka ho lekana dikgweding.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa Saanen ya Afrika-Dzonga hi nhlayo ya nkarhi wa masi, ku nga ri vukhale hi malembe: ntikelo wa masi wa avhareji hi nkarhi lowu ringanisiweke wa masiku ya 305 a wu ri 947.3 kg eka ku tswala ko sungula, 1043.2 eka ka vumbirhi, 1073.4 eka ka vunharhu, 1020.3 eka ka vumune, 972.8 eka ka vuntlhanu, 901.6 eka ka vutsevu ni 775.4 eka ka ≥7. Mintlawa leyi ya ARC leyi rhekhodiweke masi ngopfu a yi ri mintlhambi ya ku tswalisa ya nhlayiso lowukulu/wa le xiringan'weni. Rhekhoda siku ra xiviri ro tswala swimbudzana, nhlayo ya nkarhi wa masi ni masi lama hlengeletiweke; u nga avanyisi tinhlayo hinkwato leti hi ku ringana eka tin'hweti.
rows.ve: Tshikombo tsha Saanen tsha Afrika Tshipembe nga nomboro ya tshifhinga tsha u ṋea mafhi, hu si miṅwaha ya vhukale: avhareji ya tshileme tsha mafhi nga tshifhinga tsho linganyiswaho tsha maḓuvha a 305 yo vha i 947.3 kg kha u beba ha u thoma, 1043.2 kha ha vhuvhili, 1073.4 kha ha vhuraru, 1020.3 kha ha vhuṋa, 972.8 kha ha vhuṱanu, 901.6 kha ha vhurathi na 775.4 kha ha ≥7. Zwigwada izwi zwa ARC zwi re na rekhodo dza mafhi kanzhi zwo vha zwi miṱambi ya u bebisa ya ndondolo yo khwaṱhaho/ya vhukati. Ṅwalani datumu ya vhukuma ya u beba zwibudzana, nomboro ya tshifhinga tsha mafhi na mafhi o kuvhanganywaho; ni songo kovhekanya ṱhanganyelo idzi nga u lingana kha miṅwedzi.

rows.english: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen, 0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.
rows.zu: EPutukwane eduze kwasePolokwane, izimbuzikazi ezincelisayo ezingu-179 ezidla emadlelweni abanzi ezinokudla okwengeziwe okungajwayelekile zabhekwa izinsuku ezingu-210 ngemva kokuzala. Isisindo sobisi esimaphakathi sasingu-1.45 kg/day kuma-Saanen, 0.75 kuma-British Alpine no-0.56 kuma-Toggenburg ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza ubisi esabhekwa. Ukuqala kokukhiqiza ubisi kwedlula isigaba esiphakathi nesokugcina; ukuzala ngo-Mashi–Ephreli kwaba ngcono kuno-Okthoba–Novemba kuleli qembu. Lezi zimo zihlukile kumarekhodi emihlambi yokuzalanisa. Xoxa ngendawo ngezilwane ezijwayele indawo nokudla; lezi akuzona izethembiso zamalitha/ngosuku noma zonyaka wonke.
rows.st: Putukwane pela Polokwane, dipodi tse tshehadi tse anyesang tse 179 tlasa phepo ya makgulo a maholo tse ekelletswang dijo ka dinako tse sa tsitsang di ile tsa shejwa matsatsi a 210 ka mora ho tswala. Boima ba lebese bo karolelano e ne e le 1.45 kg/day bakeng sa Saanen, 0.75 bakeng sa British Alpine le 0.56 bakeng sa Toggenburg nakong ya tlhahiso ya lebese e shebilweng. Qalo ya tlhahiso ya lebese e ne e feta bohareng le qetellong; ho tswala ka Hlakubele–Mmesa ho hlahisitse hantle ho feta ka Mphalane–Pundungwane sehlopheng sena. Maemo ana a fapana le direkoto tsa mehlape ya ho tswadisa. Buisanang sebakeng sa heno ka diphoofolo tse ikamahantseng le sebaka le dijo; tsena ha se ditshepiso tsa dilitara/letsatsi kapa tsa selemo kaofela.
rows.ts: EPutukwane ekusuhi na Polokwane, timbuti ta xisati leti mamisaka ta 179 leti dyaka madyelo lama anameke ti engeteleriwa swakudya hi nkarhi lowu nga tshamisekangiki ti langutiwe ku ringana masiku ya 210 endzhaku ka ku tswala. Ntikelo wa masi wa avhareji a wu ri 1.45 kg/day eka Saanen, 0.75 eka British Alpine ni 0.56 eka Toggenburg hi nkarhi wa masi lowu langutiweke. Nkarhi wo sungula wa masi wu humelerisile ku hundza wa le xikari ni wo hetelela; ku tswala hi Nyenyankulu–Dzivamisoko ku tlurile ka Nhlangula–Hukuri eka ntlawa lowu. Swiyimo leswi swi hambana ni tirhekhodo ta mintlhambi ya ku tswalisa. Burisanani endhawini hi swifuwo leswi tolovelaka ndhawu ni swakudya; leswi a hi switshembiso swa tilitara/siku kumbe swa lembe hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Ngei Putukwane tsini na Polokwane, mbudzi dza tshisadzi dzi mamisaho dza 179 dzi ḽaho kha mafulo mahulwane dzi tshi engedzelwa zwiḽiwa nga zwifhinga zwi sa dzudzanyei dzo sedzwa maḓuvha a 210 nga murahu ha u beba. Avhareji ya tshileme tsha mafhi yo vha i 1.45 kg/day kha Saanen, 0.75 kha British Alpine na 0.56 kha Toggenburg nga tshifhinga tsha u ṋea mafhi tsho sedzwaho. Mathomo a tshifhinga tsha mafhi o fhira vhukati na magumo; u beba nga Ṱhafamuhwe–Lambamai ho fhira ha Tshimedzi–Ḽara kha tshigwada itshi. Nyimele idzi dzi fhambana na rekhodo dza miṱambi ya u bebisa. Ambani henefho nga zwipuka zwo ḓowelaho fhethu na zwiḽiwa; hezwi a si mafulufhedziso a lithara/ḓuvha kana a ṅwaha woṱhe.

rows.english: This is age at first KIDDING (birth of first kids), not first weaned kids. 16 months x 4.35 = 69.6 weeks; 18 months x 4.35 = 78.3 weeks, from doe birth to her giving birth for the first time. Adding the source's own ~150-day (~5-month, ~21.75-week) weaning assumption would put first WEANED kids at roughly 91-100 weeks of doe age, but that compound figure is not shown as the primary value since the field is documented as 'age/time from start (hatch, birth) to first product' and first kidding is the clearer, directly-stated milestone; the weaning offset is noted here for transparency.
rows.zu: Lokhu ubudala bokuZALA OKOKUQALA (ukuzalwa kwamazinyane okuqala), hhayi amazinyane okuqala aselunyuliwe. Izinyanga ezingu-16 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-69.6; izinyanga ezingu-18 x 4.35 = amasonto angu-78.3, kusukela ekuzalweni kwembuzikazi kuya lapho izala okokuqala. Ukwengeza ukulunyulwa okucatshangwa ngumthombo uqobo okucishe kube izinsuku ezingu-150 (cishe izinyanga ezingu-5, cishe amasonto angu-21.75) kungabeka amazinyane okuqala ASELUNYULIWE cishe emasontweni angu-91-100 obudala bembuzikazi, kodwa lelo nani elihlanganisiwe alikhonjiswa njengenani eliyinhloko ngoba le nkambu ichazwa 'njengobudala/isikhathi kusukela ekuqaleni (ukuchanyuselwa, ukuzalwa) kuya kumkhiqizo wokuqala', futhi ukuzala kokuqala kuyisigaba esicacile esishiwo ngqo; lesi sikhathi esengeziwe sokulunyulwa sibhalwe lapha ukuze konke kucace.
rows.st: Tsena ke dilemo tsa ho TSWALA MADINYANE LA PELE (ho tswalwa ha madinyane a pele), eseng madinyane a pele a kgwesitsweng. Dikgwedi tse 16 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 69.6; dikgwedi tse 18 x 4.35 = dibeke tse 78.3, ho tloha ho tswalweng ha podi e tshehadi ho isa ha e tswala la pele. Ho eketsa kakanyo ya mohlodi ka boyona ya ho kgwesa ya matsatsi a ka bang 150 (dikgwedi tse ka bang 5, dibeke tse ka bang 21.75) ho ka beha madinyane a pele A KGWESITSWENG dilemong tsa podi tsa dibeke tse ka bang 91-100, empa palo eo e kopantsweng ha e bontshwe e le palo e ka sehloohong hobane sebaka sena sa dintlha se hlaloswa e le 'dilemo/nako ho tloha qalong (ho qhotswa, ho tswalwa) ho isa sehlahisweng sa pele', mme ho tswala la pele ke mohato o hlakileng o boletsweng ka kotloloho; nako e ekeditsweng ya ho kgwesa e hlalositswe mona hore ho bonahale tsohle.
rows.ts: Lebyi i vukhale bya ku TSWALA SWIMBUDZANA RO SUNGULA (ku tswariwa ka swimbudzana swo sungula), ku nga ri swimbudzana swo sungula leswi lumuriweke. Tin'hweti ta 16 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 69.6; tin'hweti ta 18 x 4.35 = mavhiki ya 78.3, ku suka eka ku tswariwa ka mbuti ya xisati ku ya loko yi tswala ro sungula. Ku engetela mpimanyeto wa ku lumuriwa wa xihlovo hi xoxe wa kwalomu ka masiku ya 150 (tin'hweti ta kwalomu ka 5, mavhiki ya kwalomu ka 21.75) ku nga endla leswaku swimbudzana swo sungula LESWI LUMURIWEKE swi va kona eka vukhale bya mbuti ya xisati bya kwalomu ka mavhiki ya 91-100, kambe nhlayo yoleyo leyi hlanganisiweke a yi kombisiwi yi ri ya nkoka hikuva ndhawu ya vuxokoxoko yi hlamuseriwa yi ri 'vukhale/nkarhi ku suka eku sunguleni (ku tlhotlhoriwa, ku tswariwa) ku ya eka xibveledzwa xo sungula' naswona ku tswala ro sungula i xiyimo lexi nga erivaleni lexi boxiweke hi ku kongoma; ku engeteleka ka nkarhi wa ku lumuriwa ku boxiwa laha ku endla leswaku ku vonaka hinkwako.
rows.ve: Hezwi ndi miṅwaha ya u BEBA ZWIBUDZANA LWA U THOMA (u bebwa ha zwibudzana zwa u thoma), hu si zwibudzana zwa u thoma zwo lumulwaho. Miṅwedzi ya 16 x 4.35 = vhege dza 69.6; miṅwedzi ya 18 x 4.35 = vhege dza 78.3, u bva kha u bebwa ha mbudzi ya tshisadzi u swika i tshi beba lwa u thoma. U engedza nyanganyelo ya tshiko tshone tshiṋe ya u lumulwa ya maḓuvha a ṱoḓaho u vha 150 (miṅwedzi i ṱoḓaho u vha 5, vhege dzi ṱoḓaho u vha 21.75) zwi nga ita uri zwibudzana zwa u thoma ZWO LUMULWAHO zwi vhe hone kha miṅwaha ya mbudzi ya tshisadzi ya vhege dzi ṱoḓaho u vha 91-100, fhedzi mbalo iyo yo ṱanganyiswaho a i sumbedzwi sa mbalo khulwane ngauri tshipiḓa tsha mafhungo tshi ṱaluswa sa 'miṅwaha/tshifhinga u bva mathomoni (u thothonya, u bebwa) u swika kha tshibveledzwa tsha u thoma' nahone u beba lwa u thoma ndi ḽiga ḽi pfalaho ḽo bulwaho nga ho livhaho; tshifhinga tsha u lumulwa tsho engedzeaho tsho bulwa afha uri zwoṱhe zwi vhonale.

rows.english: The 2016 government goat manual distinguishes indigenous, Boer, Savanna and Kalahari Red meat-purpose stock from milk/fibre breeds, with breeding objectives and individual birth, weaning, weight and sale records. Uncontrolled communal mating can produce births at any time; that does not establish meat or weaned-kid availability all year. Choose stock for the local system and record survival and product stage before forecasting quantities.
rows.zu: Incwadi kahulumeni yezimbuzi yango-2016 ihlukanisa izilwane zenyama zendabuko, Boer, Savanna ne-Kalahari Red ezinhlotsheni zobisi/zoboya, inezinhloso zokuzalanisa namarekhodi esilwane ngasinye okuzalwa, ukulunyulwa, isisindo nokuthengiswa. Ukukhwelana komphakathi okungalawulwayo kungenza kuzalwe noma nini; lokho akuqinisekisi ukutholakala kwenyama noma kwamazinyane aselunyuliwe unyaka wonke. Khetha izilwane ezifanele uhlelo lwendawo bese urekhoda ukusinda nesigaba somkhiqizo ngaphambi kokubikezela amanani.
rows.st: Bukana ya mmuso ya dipodi ya 2016 e arola diphoofolo tsa nama tsa setso, Boer, Savanna le Kalahari Red mefuteng ya lebese/faeba, e na le dipheo tsa ho tswadisa le direkoto tsa phoofolo ka nngwe tsa ho tswalwa, ho kgweswa, boima le ho rekiswa. Ho nyalana ho sa laolweng diphoofolong tsa kopanelo ho ka hlahisa madinyane ka nako efe kapa efe; seo ha se tiise ho fumaneha ha nama kapa madinyane a kgwesitsweng selemo kaofela. Kgetha diphoofolo tse loketseng mokgwa wa sebaka sa heno mme o rekote ho phela le mohato wa sehlahiswa pele o bolela dipalo esale pele.
rows.ts: Buku ya mfumo ya timbuti ya 2016 yi hambanisa swifuwo swa nyama swa ndhavuko, Boer, Savanna na Kalahari Red ni tinxaka ta masi/voya, yi ri ni swikongomelo swa ku tswalisa ni tirhekhodo ta xifuwo xin'wana ni xin'wana ta ku tswariwa, ku lumuriwa, ntikelo ni ku xavisiwa. Ku hlanganela masangu loku nga lawuriwiki eka swifuwo swa vaaki ku nga endla leswaku ku tswariwa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana; leswi a swi tiyisisi nyama kumbe swimbudzana leswi lumuriweke lembe hinkwaro. Hlawula swifuwo leswi faneleke mafambiselo ya ndhawu kutani u rhekhoda ku hanya ni xiyimo xa xibveledzwa u nga si vhumbha tinhlayo.
rows.ve: Bugu ya muvhuso ya mbudzi ya 2016 i khethekanya zwipuka zwa ṋama zwa sialala, Boer, Savanna na Kalahari Red na tshaka dza mafhi/vhukuse, i na zwipikwa zwa u bebisa na rekhodo dza tshipuka tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe dza u bebwa, u lumulwa, tshileme na u rengiswa. U ṱangana ha u bebisa hu sa langwi kha zwipuka zwa tshitshavha hu nga ita uri zwi bebwe tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe; izwo a zwi khwaṱhisedzi uri hu na ṋama kana zwibudzana zwo lumulwaho ṅwaha woṱhe. Nangani zwipuka zwo teaho maitele a henefho ni ṅwale u tshila na ḽiga ḽa tshibveledzwa phanḓa ha u vhumba zwivhalo.

rows.english: In KZN Highland Sourveld smallholder systems, winter and early-spring feed shortage can restrict goats. Autumn-kidding does feed kids through winter; spring-kidding does face late-pregnancy feed shortage, especially with late rains. Plan local winter feed and monitor weights with extension support; this is regional care context, not kg or a universal kidding calendar.
rows.zu: Ezinhlelweni zabalimi abancane ze-KZN Highland Sourveld, ukuswelakala kokudla ebusika nasekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo kungakhawulela izimbuzi. Izimbuzikazi ezizala ekwindla zondla amazinyane phakathi nobusika; ezizala entwasahlobo zibhekana nokuswelakala kokudla ekupheleni kokukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi uma izimvula ziphuza ukufika. Hlela ukudla kwasebusika kwendawo bese uqapha izisindo ngosizo lwabaluleki bezolimo; lokhu kuyisimo sokunakekela sesifunda, hhayi ama-kg noma ikhalenda lokuzala lezindawo zonke.
rows.st: Mekgweng ya barui ba banyane ya KZN Highland Sourveld, kgaello ya dijo mariha le qalong ya selemo e ka sitisa dipodi. Dipodi tse tshehadi tse tswalang ka hwetla di fepa madinyane mariha; tse tswalang nakong ya selemo di tobana le kgaello ya dijo qetellong ya boimana, haholoholo ha dipula di fihla morao. Rera dijo tsa mariha tsa sebaka sa heno mme o lekole boima ka tshehetso ya baeletsi ba temo; ena ke moelelo wa tlhokomelo wa sebaka, eseng kg kapa khalendara ya ho tswala e sebetsang hohle.
rows.ts: Eka mafambiselo ya varimi lavatsongo ya KZN Highland Sourveld, ku kayivela ka swakudya hi xixika ni le ku sunguleni ka ximun'wana ku nga sivela timbuti. Timbuti ta xisati leti tswalaka hi xixikana ti phamela swimbudzana hi xixika; leti tswalaka hi ximun'wana ti langutana ni ku kayivela ka swakudya emakumu ka ku tika, ngopfu loko timpfula ti fika endzhaku ka nkarhi. Pulana swakudya swa ndhawu swa xixika ni ku languta mintikelo hi nseketelo wa vatsundzuxi va vurimi; lowu i mongo wa nhlayiso wa xifundzha, ku nga ri kg kumbe khalendara ya ku tswala leyi tirhaka hinkwako.
rows.ve: Kha maitele a vhafuwi vhaṱuku a KZN Highland Sourveld, u ṱahela ha zwiḽiwa vhuria na mathomoni a luṱavula zwi nga khakhisa mbudzi. Mbudzi dza tshisadzi dzi bebaho tshifhefho dzi mamisa zwibudzana vhuria; dzi bebaho luṱavula dzi ṱangana na u ṱahela ha zwiḽiwa magumoni a u ḓihwala, zwihuluhulu arali mvula ya lenga u na. Dzudzanyani zwiḽiwa zwa vhuria zwa henefho ni sedze zwileme nga thuso ya vhaeletshedzi vha vhulimi; hezwi ndi mafhungo a ndondolo a dzingu, hu si kg kana khalenda ya u beba i shumaho fhethu hoṱhe.

rows.english: The reported weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 kids weaned per doe mated. The source describes observations over twenty years for extensive Boer does at 295 mm rainfall; it does not state kids weaned per doe per calendar year. This is a reproductive outcome, not kg of live animals or dressed meat. A separate mean litter size of 1.93 kids born per parturition has a different denominator and stage and is not merged into this figure.
rows.zu: Izinga lokulunyulwa elibikiwe lingu-149%, noma amazinyane angu-1.49 aselunyuliwe ngembuzikazi ekhwelisiwe. Umthombo uchaza okwabonwa phakathi neminyaka engamashumi amabili ezimbuzikazini ze-Boer ezidla emadlelweni abanzi endaweni enemvula engu-295 mm; awusho amazinyane aselunyuliwe ngembuzikazi ngonyaka wekhalenda. Lokhu kungumphumela wokuzalana, hhayi ama-kg ezilwane eziphilayo noma enyama elungisiwe. Esinye isilinganiso sobukhulu beqoqo lamazinyane esingu-1.93 azalwa ekuzaleni ngakunye sineyunithi yokubala nesigaba esihlukile futhi asihlanganiswa naleli nani.
rows.st: Sekgahla sa ho kgwesa se tlalehilweng ke 149%, kapa madinyane a kgwesitsweng a 1.49 ka podi e tshehadi e kopantsweng le e tona. Mohlodi o hlalosa tse bonweng dilemong tse mashome a mabedi bakeng sa dipodi tsa Boer tse tshehadi tsa makgulo a maholo pula e le 295 mm; ha o bolele madinyane a kgwesitsweng ka podi e tshehadi ka selemo sa khalendara. Sena ke sephetho sa ho tswala, eseng kg ya diphoofolo tse phelang kapa nama e lokisitsweng. Karolelano e nngwe ya boholo ba sehlopha sa madinyane a tswetsweng ka tshwalo ya 1.93 e na le motheo wa palo le mohato o fapaneng mme ha e kopantswe le palo ena.
rows.ts: Mpimo wa ku lumuriwa lowu vikiweke i 149%, kumbe swimbudzana leswi lumuriweke swa 1.49 hi mbuti ya xisati leyi hlanganisiweke ni ya xinuna. Xihlovo xi hlamusela leswi langutiweke eka malembe ya makume mambirhi eka timbuti ta xisati ta Boer ta madyelo lama anameke eka mpfula ya 295 mm; a xi vuli swimbudzana leswi lumuriweke hi mbuti ya xisati hi lembe ra khalendara. Lowu i mbuyelo wa ku tswala, ku nga ri kg ta swifuwo leswi hanyaka kumbe nyama leyi lunghisiweke. Avhareji yin'wana ya nhlayo ya swimbudzana swa 1.93 leswi tswariwaka hi ku tswala kun'wana ni kun'wana yi ni xisekelo xa nhlayo ni xiyimo lexi hambaneke naswona a yi hlanganisiwi ni nhlayo leyi.
rows.ve: Mpimo wa u lumula wo vhigwaho ndi 149%, kana zwibudzana zwo lumulwaho zwa 1.49 nga mbudzi ya tshisadzi yo ṱanganyiswaho na ya tshinna. Tshiko tshi ṱalusa zwe zwa vhonwa kha miṅwaha ya mahumi mavhili kha mbudzi dza tshisadzi dza Boer dza mafulo mahulwane hu na mvula ya 295 mm; a tshi buli zwibudzana zwo lumulwaho nga mbudzi ya tshisadzi nga ṅwaha wa khalenda. Hezwi ndi mvelelo ya u beba, hu si kg ya zwipuka zwi tshilaho kana ṋama yo lugiselwaho. Iṅwe avhareji ya tshivhalo tsha zwibudzana tsha 1.93 zwi bebwaho kha u beba huṅwe na huṅwe i na mutheo wa u vhala na ḽiga zwo fhambanaho nahone a i ṱanganyiswi na mbalo iyi.

rows.english: Table 1 gives separate ranges by physiological class of the same animal (sow): pregnant sows 10-18 L/day and lactating sows 18-23 L/day. Combined here into a single sow-herd range [10,23] spanning both states, rather than mixing in the table's other classes (nursery, grower, finishing pigs, boars), which are a different animalUnit. South Africa (general smallholder/commercial training-manual figure, not tied to one system).
rows.zu: Ithebula 1 linikeza ububanzi obuhlukene ngokwesigaba somzimba sesilwane esifanayo (ingulube yensikazi ezalayo): izinsikazi ezikhulelwe 10-18 L/day nezincelisayo 18-23 L/day. Kuhlanganiswe lapha kwaba ububanzi obubodwa bomhlambi wezinsikazi ezizalayo obungu-[10,23] obuhlanganisa zombili izimo, kunokuba kuxutshwe nezinye izigaba zethebula (amachwane asanda kulunyulwa, ezikhulayo, ezilungiselwa ukuhlaba, abesilisa), ezine-animalUnit ehlukile. INingizimu Afrika (inani lencwadi yokuqeqesha elijwayelekile labalimi abancane/abohwebo, elingaboshelwe ohlelweni olulodwa).
rows.st: Tafole 1 e fana ka meedi e arohaneng ka boemo ba mmele ba phoofolo e tshwanang (kolobe e tshehadi ya ho tswadisa): tse emereng 10-18 L/day le tse anyesang 18-23 L/day. E kopantswe mona ho ba moedi o le mong wa mohlape wa dikolobe tse tshehadi wa [10,23] o akaretsang maemo ao ka bobedi, ho ena le ho kopanya dihlopha tse ding tsa tafole (madinyane a kgwesitsweng, tse holang, tse qetellang ho nontshwa, tse tona), tse nang le animalUnit e fapaneng. Afrika Borwa (palo ya bukana ya thupelo ya kakaretso ya barui ba banyane/ba kgwebo, e sa tlamelwang mokgweng o le mong).
rows.ts: Tafula 1 ri nyika mimpimo leyi hambaneke hi xiyimo xa miri xa xifuwo xin'we (nguluve ya xisati yo tswalisa): ta xisati leti tikeke 10-18 L/day ni leti mamisaka 18-23 L/day. Swi hlanganisiwile laha swi va mpimo wun'we wa ntlhambi wa tinguluve ta xisati wa [10,23] lowu katsaka swiyimo hatimbirhi, ematshan'wini yo hlanganisa mintlawa yin'wana ya tafula (swingulubyana leswi lumuriweke, leti kulaka, leti lunghiseriwaka ku tlhaviwa, ta xinuna), leyi nga ni animalUnit yo hambana. Afrika-Dzonga (nhlayo ya buku ya vuleteri yo angarhela ya varimi lavatsongo/va mabindzu, leyi nga bohiwangiki eka mafambiselo man'we).
rows.ve: Thebuḽa 1 ḽi ṋea mikhano yo khethekanywaho nga vhuimo ha muvhili wa tshipuka tshithihi (nguluvhe ya tshisadzi ya u bebisa): dza tshisadzi dzo ḓihwalaho 10-18 L/day na dzi mamisaho 18-23 L/day. Zwo ṱanganyiswa afha zwa vha mikhano mithihi ya muṱambi wa nguluvhe dza tshisadzi ya [10,23] i katelaho nyimele dzoṱhe mbili, nṱhani ha u ṱanganyisa zwiṅwe zwigwada zwa thebuḽa (zwiguludzwana zwo lumulwaho, dzi aluwaho, dzi lugiselwaho u ṱhavhiwa, dza tshinna), zwi re na animalUnit yo fhambanaho. Afrika Tshipembe (mbalo ya bugu ya vhugudisi ya u angaredza ya vhafuwi vhaṱuku/vha mabindu, i songo vhofhiwaho kha maitele mathihi).

rows.english: ARC Table 1 lists pregnant sows at 10–18 L drinking water/day and lactating sows at 18–23 L/day. These are breeding-sow stages, not one amount for every pig. Farrowing care separates sow cooling from piglet warmth; outdoor systems need locally adapted hardy stock, shade and shelter. Confirm stage, reliable clean water, feed and housing locally. The manual supplies no verified edible kg per breeding sow for this plan.
rows.zu: Ithebula 1 le-ARC libala izinsikazi zezingulube ezikhulelwe ku-10–18 L drinking water/day nezincelisayo ku-18–23 L/day. Lezi yizigaba zezinsikazi ezizalayo, hhayi inani elilodwa lazo zonke izingulube. Ukunakekela lapho kuzalwa amazinyane kuhlukanisa ukupholisa unina nokufudumeza amachwane; izinhlelo zangaphandle zidinga izilwane eziqinile ezijwayele indawo, umthunzi nendawo yokukhosela. Qinisekisa isigaba, amanzi ahlanzekile atholakala njalo, ukudla nezindlu ngendawo. Incwadi ayinikezi ama-kg aqinisekisiwe adliwayo ngengulube yensikazi ezalayo yalolu hlelo.
rows.st: ARC Tafole 1 e thathamisa dikolobe tse tshehadi tse emereng ka 10–18 L drinking water/day le tse anyesang ka 18–23 L/day. Ana ke maemo a dikolobe tse tshehadi tsa ho tswadisa, eseng palo e le nngwe bakeng sa kolobe e nngwe le e nngwe. Tlhokomelo ya ho tswala madinyane e arola ho phodisa kolobe e tshehadi le ho futhumatsa madinyane; mekgwa ya kantle e hloka diphoofolo tse tiileng tse ikamahantseng le sebaka, moriti le bodulo. Netefatsa boemo, metsi a hlwekileng a tshepahalang, dijo le bodulo sebakeng sa heno. Bukana ha e fane ka kg e netefaditsweng e ka jewang ka kolobe e tshehadi ya ho tswadisa bakeng sa moralo ona.
rows.ts: ARC Tafula 1 ri longoloxa tinguluve ta xisati leti tikeke eka 10–18 L drinking water/day ni leti mamisaka eka 18–23 L/day. Lawa i swiyimo swa tinguluve ta xisati to tswalisa, ku nga ri nhlayo yin'we ya nguluve yin'wana ni yin'wana. Nhlayiso loko ti tswala wu hambanisa ku horisa nguluve ya xisati ni ku kufumeta swingulubyana; mafambiselo ya le handle ma lava swifuwo leswi tiyeke leswi tolovelaka ndhawu, ndzhuti ni vutumbelo. Tiyisisa xiyimo, mati yo tenga lama kumekaka nkarhi hinkwawo, swakudya ni tindlu endhawini. Buku a yi nyiki kg leti dyiwaka leti tiyisisiweke hi nguluve ya xisati yo tswalisa eka pulani leyi.
rows.ve: ARC Thebuḽa 1 ḽi bula nguluvhe dza tshisadzi dzo ḓihwalaho dzi kha 10–18 L drinking water/day na dzi mamisaho dzi kha 18–23 L/day. Hezwi ndi zwiga zwa nguluvhe dza tshisadzi dza u bebisa, hu si mbalo nthihi ya nguluvhe iṅwe na iṅwe. Ndondolo musi dzi tshi beba i khethekanya u rothodza nguluvhe ya tshisadzi na u dudedza zwiguludzwana; maitele a nnḓa a ṱoḓa zwipuka zwo khwaṱhaho zwo ḓowelaho fhethu, murunzi na vhudzulo ha u tsireledzea. Khwaṱhisedzani ḽiga, maḓi o kunaho a dzulaho a tshi wanala, zwiḽiwa na vhudzulo henefho. Bugu a i ṋei kg yo khwaṱhisedzwaho i ḽiwaho nga nguluvhe ya tshisadzi ya u bebisa kha pulane iyi.

rows.english: FAO general backyard target, not a South African observed rate. The 30–35 young per doe annually have reached slaughter or reproduction age after allowance for post-weaning loss; they are not merely weaned and are not kg of meat. The source models six litters and 5.5 surviving young per litter, describing a 30-rabbit objective; an extra litter raises its stated objective to 35. Do not combine this backyard target with grower-house carcass weight from a different trial.
rows.zu: Inhloso evamile ye-FAO yokufuya egcekeni, hhayi izinga elabonwa eNingizimu Afrika. Amazinyane angu-30–35 ngensikazi yonogwaja ngonyaka asefinyelele ebudaleni bokuhlatshwa noma bokuzala ngemva kokubalwa kokulahleka ngemva kokulunyulwa; awagcini ngokuba aselunyuliwe futhi awawona ama-kg enyama. Umthombo ubala amaqoqo okuzala ayisithupha namazinyane angu-5.5 asindile eqoqweni ngalinye, uchaza inhloso yonogwaja abangu-30; iqoqo elilodwa elengeziwe likhuphula inhloso yawo eshiwo ibe ngu-35. Ungahlanganisi le nhloso yokufuya egcekeni nesisindo sesidumbu esivela endlini yokukhulisa konunye ukuhlolwa.
rows.st: Sepheo sa kakaretso sa FAO sa ho rua ka jareteng, eseng sekgahla se bonweng Afrika Borwa. Madinyane a 30–35 ka mmutla o tshehadi ka selemo a se a fihletse dilemo tsa ho hlajwa kapa ho tswala ka mora ho dumella tahlehelo ka mora ho kgweswa; ha se feela a kgwesitsweng ebile ha se kg ya nama. Mohlodi o bala dihlopha tse tswetsweng tse tsheletseng le madinyane a phelang a 5.5 ka sehlopha, o hlalosa sepheo sa mebutla e 30; sehlopha se le seng se ekeditsweng se nyolla sepheo sa wona se boletsweng ho 35. O se ke wa kopanya sepheo sena sa ho rua ka jareteng le boima ba setopo sa ntlo ya kgodiso se tswang tekong e fapaneng.
rows.ts: Xikongomelo xo angarhela xa FAO xa ku fuwa endzhaku ka muti, ku nga ri mpimo lowu voniweke eAfrika-Dzonga. Mimpfundla leyitsongo ya 30–35 hi mpfundla wa xisati hi lembe swi fike eka vukhale bya ku tlhaviwa kumbe ku tswala endzhaku ko tekela enhlokweni ku lahleka endzhaku ka ku lumuriwa; a swo lumuriwa ntsena naswona a hi kg ta nyama. Xihlovo xi hlayela mintlawa ya ku tswala ya tsevu ni mimpfundla leyitsongo leyi hanyeke ya 5.5 hi ntlawa, xi hlamusela xikongomelo xa mimpfundla ya 30; ntlawa wun'wana wo tswala wu tlakusa xikongomelo xa xona lexi boxiweke ku ya eka 35. U nga hlanganisi xikongomelo lexi xa ku fuwa endzhaku ka muti ni ntikelo wa ntsumbu wa yindlu ya ku kurisela ku suka eka ndzavisiso wun'wana.
rows.ve: Tshipikwa tsha u angaredza tsha FAO tsha u fuwa muṱani, hu si mpimo wo vhonwaho Afrika Tshipembe. Mivhuḓa miṱuku ya 30–35 nga muvhuḓa wa tshisadzi nga ṅwaha yo swika kha miṅwaha ya u ṱhavhiwa kana u beba nga murahu ha u dzhiela nṱha u lovha nga murahu ha u lumulwa; a yo ngo tou lumulwa fhedzi nahone a si kg ya ṋama. Tshiko tshi vhala zwigwada zwa u beba zwa rathi na mivhuḓa miṱuku yo tshilaho ya 5.5 nga tshigwada, tshi ṱalusa tshipikwa tsha mivhuḓa ya 30; tshiṅwe tshigwada tsha u beba tshi gonysa tshipikwa tshatsho tsho bulwaho tsha vha 35. Ni songo ṱanganyisa tshipikwa itshi tsha u fuwa muṱani na tshileme tsha tshitumbu tshi bvaho kha nnḓu ya u alusa kha muṅwe mulingo.

rows.english: 279 days / 365 = 0.76 years. This figure is from French INTENSIVE commercial rabbitries (average of 1992 national recording-scheme data), NOT backyard/extensive hutches - the source gives no separate productive-life figure for backyard systems (see gaps). Treat as a lower-bound / industrial-system reference only.
rows.zu: Izinsuku ezingu-279 / 365 = iminyaka engu-0.76. Leli nani livela ezindaweni zokufuya onogwaja zokuhweba zaseFrance EZINAKEKELWA KAKHULU (isilinganiso sedatha yango-1992 yohlelo lukazwelonke lokurekhoda), HHAYI ezindlwaneni zasegcekeni/emadlelweni abanzi - umthombo awunikezi inani elehlukile lokuphila kokukhiqiza kwezinhlelo zasegcekeni (bheka okushodayo). Kubheke njengesikhombo somkhawulo ophansi/sohlelo lwemboni kuphela.
rows.st: Matsatsi a 279 / 365 = dilemo tse 0.76. Palo ena e tswa dibakeng tsa kgwebo tsa mebutla tsa Fora tsa TLHOKOMELO E MATLA (karolelano ya dintlha tsa 1992 tsa lenaneo la naha la ho rekota), ESENG matlong a ka jareteng/a tlhokomelo ya makgulo a maholo - mohlodi ha o fane ka palo e fapaneng ya bophelo ba tlhahiso bakeng sa mekgwa ya ka jareteng (sheba dikgeo). E nke e le tshupiso ya moedi o tlase/ya mokgwa wa indasteri feela.
rows.ts: Masiku ya 279 / 365 = malembe ya 0.76. Nhlayo leyi yi huma eka mabindzu ya mimpfundla ya Furwa ya NHLAYISO LOWUKULU (avhareji ya vuxokoxoko bya 1992 bya nongonoko wa tiko wo rhekhoda), KU NGA RI eka tindlu ta le ndzhaku ka muti/ta mafambiselo lama anameke - xihlovo a xi nyiki nhlayo yin'wana ya nkarhi wa vuhumelerisi eka mafambiselo ya le ndzhaku ka muti (vona leswi kayivelaka). Yi teke yi ri xikombo xa mpimo wa le hansi/xa mafambiselo ya indasitiri ntsena.
rows.ve: Maḓuvha a 279 / 365 = miṅwaha ya 0.76. Mbalo iyi i bva kha mabindu a mivhuḓa a Fura a NDONDOLO YO KHWAṰHAHO (avhareji ya mafhungo a 1992 a mbekanyamushumo ya lushaka ya rekhodo), HU SI nnḓu dza muṱani/maitele a mafulo mahulwane - tshiko a tshi ṋei mbalo ya vhutshilo ha vhubveledzi yo fhambanaho ya maitele a muṱani (sedzani zwi ṱahelaho). Zwi dzhieni sa tshikombo tsha mukhano wa fhasi/maitele a nḓowetshumo fhedzi.

rows.english: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 to 0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, indoor/hutch cage per single breeding adult (one buck or doe per cage), 50-60 cm high. FAO (general, not SA-specific). A separate FAO table (p.174, Fort & Martin 1981) gives a doe's cage as 65-70 cm (front) x 50 cm (depth) = 0.325-0.35 m2 and a buck's cage as 40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - a narrower alternative figure from the same book, not merged into the range above to avoid mixing two different tabulated sources.
rows.zu: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 kuya ku-0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, ikheji langaphakathi/lendlwana ngesilwane esisodwa esikhulile sokuzalanisa (isilisa noma insikazi eyodwa ngekheji), ukuphakama okungu-50-60 cm. I-FAO (ngokujwayelekile, hhayi okuqondene neNingizimu Afrika). Elinye ithebula le-FAO (ikhasi 174, Fort & Martin 1981) linikeza ikheji lensikazi elingu-65-70 cm (ngaphambili) x 50 cm (ukujula) = 0.325-0.35 m2 kanye nekheji lesilisa elingu-40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - elinye inani elinendawo encane elivela encwadini efanayo, elingahlanganiswa nobubanzi obungenhla ukuze kungaxutshwa imithombo emibili ehlukene esemathebuleni.
rows.st: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 ho isa ho 0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, lesaka la ka tlung/la mmutla ka phoofolo e le nngwe e hodileng ya ho tswadisa (e tona kapa e tshehadi e le nngwe ka lesaka), bolelele ba 50-60 cm. FAO (ya kakaretso, eseng e tobileng Afrika Borwa). Tafole e nngwe ya FAO (leq.174, Fort & Martin 1981) e fana ka lesaka la e tshehadi la 65-70 cm (ka pele) x 50 cm (botebo) = 0.325-0.35 m2 le lesaka la e tona la 40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - palo e nngwe e nang le sebaka se senyane bukeng e tshwanang, e sa kopanngweng le moedi o ka hodimo ho qoba ho kopanya mehlodi e mmedi e fapaneng e leng ditafoleng.
rows.ts: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 ku ya eka 0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, kheji ya le ndlwini/ya mpfundla hi xifuwo xin'we lexi kuleke xo tswalisa (xa xinuna kumbe xa xisati xin'we hi kheji), ku tlakuka ka 50-60 cm. FAO (yo angarhela, ku nga ri leyi kongomaka Afrika-Dzonga). Tafula rin'wana ra FAO (tl.174, Fort & Martin 1981) ri nyika kheji ya xisati yi ri 65-70 cm (emahlweni) x 50 cm (ku enta) = 0.325-0.35 m2 ni kheji ya xinuna yi ri 40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - nhlayo yin'wana ya ndhawu yitsongo ku suka eka buku yin'we, leyi nga hlanganisiwiki ni mpimo lowu nga laha henhla ku papalata ku hlanganisa swihlovo swimbirhi leswi hambaneke leswi nga ematafuleni.
rows.ve: 0.60x0.80=0.48 m2 u ya kha 0.70x1.00=0.70 m2, bogisi ḽa nḓuni/ḽa muvhuḓa nga tshipuka tshithihi tsho aluwaho tsha u bebisa (tsha tshinna kana tsha tshisadzi tshithihi nga bogisi), vhulapfu ha 50-60 cm. FAO (ya u angaredza, hu si yo livhaho kha Afrika Tshipembe). Ḽiṅwe thebuḽa ḽa FAO (siaṱ.174, Fort & Martin 1981) ḽi ṋea bogisi ḽa tshisadzi sa 65-70 cm (phanḓa) x 50 cm (vhudzivha) = 0.325-0.35 m2 na bogisi ḽa tshinna sa 40x50 cm = 0.20 m2 - iṅwe mbalo ya tshikhala tshiṱuku i bvaho kha bugu yeneyo, i songo ṱanganyiswaho na mikhano i re afho nṱha u itela u sa ṱanganyisa zwiko zwivhili zwo fhambanaho zwi re kha thebuḽa.

rows.english: South African grower reference: New Zealand White and Phendula rabbits in the 2017 Stellenbosch trial were slaughtered at about 11 weeks from birth. Overall means were 2.62 kg live slaughter weight, 1.55 kg hot carcass, 1.48 kg chilled carcass and 1.26 kg reference carcass with head and red offal removed, still including bones. Balanced pellets and water were freely available in a grower house. These weights are not boneless meat or annual doe output; do not multiply them by the unrelated FAO backyard target.
rows.zu: Isikhombo saseNingizimu Afrika sezilwane ezikhuliswayo: onogwaja be-New Zealand White ne-Phendula ekuhlolweni kwaseStellenbosch kwango-2017 bahlatshwa benamasonto acishe abe ngu-11 kusukela ekuzalweni. Izilinganiso zonke zazingu-2.62 kg isisindo esiphilayo sokuhlatshwa, 1.55 kg isidumbu esishisayo, 1.48 kg isidumbu esipholisiwe no-1.26 kg isidumbu sesikhombo esikhishwe ikhanda nezitho zangaphakathi ezibomvu, sisahlanganisa amathambo. Ukudla okuyizinhlayiyana okulinganisiwe namanzi kwakutholakala ngokukhululeka endlini yokukhulisa. Lezi zisindo aziyona inyama engenamathambo noma umkhiqizo wonyaka wensikazi yonogwaja; ungaziphindaphindi ngenhloso ye-FAO yokufuya egcekeni engahlobene nazo.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya Afrika Borwa ya mebutla e hodiswang: mebutla ya New Zealand White le Phendula tekong ya Stellenbosch ya 2017 e ile ya hlajwa ha e le dibeke tse ka bang 11 ho tloha ho tswalwa. Dikarolelano kaofela e ne e le 2.62 kg ya boima bo phelang ha ho hlajwa, 1.55 kg ya setopo se tjhesang, 1.48 kg ya setopo se phodisitsweng le 1.26 kg ya setopo sa tshupiso se tlositsweng hlooho le ditho tse kgubedu tsa ka hare, se sa ntse se e-na le masapo. Dijo tsa diphelete tse leka-lekaneng le metsi di ne di fumaneha ka bolokolohi ntlong ya kgodiso. Boima bona ha se nama e se nang masapo kapa tlhahiso ya selemo ya mmutla o tshehadi; o se ke wa bo atisa ka sepheo sa FAO sa ho rua ka jareteng se sa amaneng le bona.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa Afrika-Dzonga xa mimpfundla leyi kurisiwaka: mimpfundla ya New Zealand White na Phendula eka ndzavisiso wa Stellenbosch wa 2017 yi tlhaviwe eka kwalomu ka mavhiki ya 11 ku suka eku tswariweni. Tiavhareji hinkwato a ti ri 2.62 kg ya ntikelo lowu hanyaka loko yi tlhaviwa, 1.55 kg ya ntsumbu lowu hisaka, 1.48 kg ya ntsumbu lowu horisiweke ni 1.26 kg ya ntsumbu wa xikombo lowu susiweke nhloko ni swirho swo tshwuka swa le ndzeni, wa ha katsa marhambu. Tiphelete leti ringaniseriweke ta swakudya ni mati a swi kumeka hi ku ntshunxeka endlwini ya ku kurisela. Mintikelo leyi a hi nyama leyi nga riki ni marhambu kumbe vuhumelerisi bya lembe bya mpfundla wa xisati; u nga yi andzisi hi xikongomelo xa FAO xa ku fuwa endzhaku ka muti lexi nga fambelaniki na yona.
rows.ve: Tshikombo tsha Afrika Tshipembe tsha mivhuḓa i alusiwaho: mivhuḓa ya New Zealand White na Phendula kha mulingo wa Stellenbosch wa 2017 yo ṱhavhiwa kha vhege dzi ṱoḓaho u vha 11 u bva kha u bebwa. Avhareji dzoṱhe dzo vha dzi 2.62 kg ya tshileme tshi tshilaho musi hu tshi ṱhavhiwa, 1.55 kg ya tshitumbu tshi fhisaho, 1.48 kg ya tshitumbu tsho rothodzwaho na 1.26 kg ya tshitumbu tsha tshikombo tsho bviswaho ṱhoho na zwiraḓo zwitswuku zwa nga ngomu, tshi kha ḓi katela marambo. Pheḽethe dza zwiḽiwa zwo linganelaho na maḓi zwo vha zwi tshi wanala hu si na mukhano kha nnḓu ya u alusa. Zwileme izwi a si ṋama i si na marambo kana vhubveledzi ha ṅwaha ha muvhuḓa wa tshisadzi; ni songo zwi andzisa nga tshipikwa tsha FAO tsha u fuwa muṱani tshi sa ṱumanywi nazwo.

rows.english: outputUnit is 'lambs born/ewe/year' rather than the suggested 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' or 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': the source explains 'Measuring accurate lambing percentages for smallholder sheep farmers is challenging as these farmers mostly farm extensively and do not keep records', and instead calculates 'Lambs born per ewe (as recorded from the surveys based on interviews with individual respondents)' - a lambing (born), not weaning, figure, self-reported by smallholder farmers rather than measured/weighed. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 lambs born/ewe/year; the range [0.61, 1.39] spans the three Western Cape smallholder districts surveyed (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), all from this one study/quote - not merged with any other document. The same paper separately states a COMMERCIAL extensive benchmark of 110-156% lambing and 94-132% weaning (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), explicitly 'expressed over ewes joined' (a different denominator/system) - not merged into this smallholder range.
rows.zu: I-outputUnit ithi 'lambs born/ewe/year' esikhundleni sesiphakamiso esithi 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' noma 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': umthombo uchaza ukuthi 'Ukukala amaphesenti okuzala anembile kubalimi abancane bezimvu kunzima ngoba laba balimi ikakhulukazi bafuya emadlelweni abanzi futhi abagcini amarekhodi', bese ubala 'Amawundlu azalwa ngemvukazi (njengoba kurekhodiwe ocwaningweni olusekelwe ezingxoxweni nomphenduli ngamunye)' - inani lokuzalwa, hhayi lokulunyulwa, elibikwe abalimi abancane ngokwabo kunokuba likalwe/ngesisindo. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 amawundlu azalwa/ngemvukazi/ngonyaka; ububanzi [0.61, 1.39] buhlanganisa izifunda ezintathu zabalimi abancane zase-Western Cape ezacwaningwa (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), konke kusuka kulolu cwaningo/amazwi acashuniwe kuphela - akuhlanganiswa nomunye umbhalo. Iphepha elifanayo lisho ngokwehlukana isilinganiso sokuqhathanisa sezohwebo emadlelweni abanzi sokuzalwa esingu-110-156% nokulunyulwa okungu-94-132% (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), lisho ngqo ukuthi 'kubalwe phezu kwezimvukazi ezifakwe ekukhwelaneni' (iyunithi yokubala/uhlelo oluhlukile) - akuhlanganiswa nalobu bubanzi babalimi abancane.
rows.st: outputUnit ke 'lambs born/ewe/year' ho ena le se sisintsweng sa 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' kapa 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': mohlodi o hlalosa hore 'Ho lekanya diphesente tsa nnete tsa ho tswala ha dinku bakeng sa barui ba banyane ho thata hobane barui bana boholo ba rua makgulong a maholo mme ha ba boloke direkoto', mme ho ena le hoo o bala 'Dikonyana tse tswetsweng ka nku e tshehadi (jwalokaha di rekotilwe diphuputsong tse thehilweng dipuisanong le moarabi ka mong)' - palo ya ho tswalwa, eseng ho kgweswa, e tlalehilweng ke barui ba banyane ho ena le ho lekanngwa/ho bekwa. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 dikonyana tse tswetsweng/nku e tshehadi/selemo; moedi wa [0.61, 1.39] o akaretsa ditereke tse tharo tsa barui ba banyane tsa Western Cape tse hlahlobilweng (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), kaofela ho tswa phuputsong/qotsong ena feela - ha o kopantswe le tokomane e nngwe. Pampiri e tshwanang e bolela ka thoko tekanyetso ya KGWEBO ya makgulo a maholo ya ho tswala ya 110-156% le ya ho kgwesa ya 94-132% (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), e bolela ka ho hlaka hore 'e balwa ho ya ka dinku tse tshehadi tse kopantsweng le tse tona' (motheo wa palo/mokgwa o fapaneng) - ha e kopantswe le moedi ona wa barui ba banyane.
rows.ts: outputUnit i 'lambs born/ewe/year' ematshan'wini ya leswi ringanyetiweke swa 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' kumbe 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': xihlovo xi hlamusela leswaku 'Ku pima tiphesente ta xiviri ta ku tswala ka tinyimpfu eka varimi lavatsongo swa tika hikuva varimi lava ngopfu va fuwa eka madyelo lama anameke naswona a va hlayisi tirhekhodo', kutani xi hlayela 'Swinyimpfana leswi tswariweke hi nyimpfu ya xisati (hilaha swi rhekhodiweke hakona eka mindzavisiso leyi sekeriweke eka mimbulavurisano ni muhlamuri wun'wana ni wun'wana)' - nhlayo ya leswi tswariweke, ku nga ri leswi lumuriweke, leyi vikiweke hi varimi lavatsongo hi voxe ku nga ri leyi pimiweke/kariweke. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 swinyimpfana leswi tswariweke/nyimpfu ya xisati/lembe; mpimo wa [0.61, 1.39] wu katsa swifundzha swinharhu swa varimi lavatsongo swa Western Cape leswi lavisisiweke (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), hinkwabyo swi huma eka ndzavisiso/ntshaho lowu wun'we - a swi hlanganisiwi ni tsalwa rin'wana. Phepha rin'we ri boxa hi ku hambana mpimo wa MABINDZU wa madyelo lama anameke wa ku tswala wa 110-156% ni ku lumuriwa ka 94-132% (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), ri vula hi ku kongoma leswaku 'swi hlayiwa hi ku ya hi tinyimpfu ta xisati leti hlanganisiweke ni ta xinuna' (xisekelo xa nhlayo/mafambiselo lama hambaneke) - a swi hlanganisiwi ni mpimo lowu wa varimi lavatsongo.
rows.ve: outputUnit ndi 'lambs born/ewe/year' nṱhani ha ho themendelwaho ha 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' kana 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': tshiko tshi ṱalusa uri 'U kala phesenthe dza vhukuma dza u beba ha nngu kha vhafuwi vhaṱuku zwi a konḓa ngauri vhafuwi avha kanzhi vha fuwa kha mafulo mahulwane nahone a vha vhulungi rekhodo', tshi vhala 'Zwingwana zwo bebwaho nga nngu ya tshisadzi (sa zwo ṅwalwaho kha ṱhoḓisiso dzo ḓitikaho nga nyambedzano na mufhinduli muṅwe na muṅwe)' - mbalo ya u bebwa, hu si ya u lumulwa, yo vhigwaho nga vhafuwi vhaṱuku vhane hu si yo kaliwaho/lingwaho tshileme. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 zwingwana zwo bebwaho/nngu ya tshisadzi/ṅwaha; mikhano ya [0.61, 1.39] i katela zwitiriki zwiraru zwa vhafuwi vhaṱuku zwa Western Cape zwo ṱoḓisiswaho (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), zwoṱhe zwi tshi bva kha ṱhoḓisiso/maipfi o redzwaho aya mathihi - a zwo ngo ṱanganyiswa na ḽiṅwe ḽiṅwalwa. Bammbiri ḽithihi ḽi bula nga thungo tshikombo tsha MABINDU tsha mafulo mahulwane tsha u beba tsha 110-156% na tsha u lumula tsha 94-132% (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), ḽi tshi bula nga ho livhaho uri 'zwi vhaliwa u ya nga nngu dza tshisadzi dzo ṱanganyiswaho na dza tshinna' (mutheo wa u vhala/maitele o fhambanaho) - a zwo ngo ṱanganyiswa na mikhano iyi ya vhafuwi vhaṱuku.

rows.english: The government sheep manual describes controlled breeding at Mara Research Station, Limpopo: June–July mating and November–December lambing to match rain and grass. This is one station breeding calendar, not mutton harvest months. Match adapted meat-purpose stock and feed locally, then record birth, survival, weaning and actual slaughter or sale; lambs born per ewe are not edible kg.
rows.zu: Incwadi kahulumeni yezimvu ichaza ukuzalanisa okulawulwayo e-Mara Research Station, Limpopo: ukukhwelana ngo-Juni–Julayi nokuzala ngo-Novemba–Disemba ukuze kuhambisane nemvula notshani. Leli yikhalenda lokuzalanisa lesiteshi esisodwa, hhayi izinyanga zokuvuna inyama yemvu. Fanisa izilwane ezifuyelwa inyama ezijwayele indawo nokudla kwendawo, bese urekhoda ukuzalwa, ukusinda, ukulunyulwa nokuhlatshwa noma ukuthengiswa kwangempela; amawundlu azalwa ngemvukazi awawona ama-kg adliwayo.
rows.st: Bukana ya mmuso ya dinku e hlalosa ho tswadisa ho laolwang Mara Research Station, Limpopo: ho nyalana ka Phupjane–Phupu le ho tswala ka Pundungwane–Tshitwe ho tsamaellana le pula le jwang. Ena ke khalendara e le nngwe ya ho tswadisa ya seteishene, eseng dikgwedi tsa kotulo ya nama ya nku. Nyalanya diphoofolo tsa nama tse ikamahantseng le sebaka le dijo tsa sebaka sa heno, ebe o rekota ho tswalwa, ho phela, ho kgweswa le ho hlajwa kapa ho rekiswa ha nnete; dikonyana tse tswetsweng ka nku e tshehadi ha se kg e ka jewang.
rows.ts: Buku ya mfumo ya tinyimpfu yi hlamusela ku tswalisa loku lawuriwaka eMara Research Station, Limpopo: ku hlanganela masangu hi Khotavuxika–Mawuwani ni ku tswala hi Hukuri–N'wendzamhala ku fambelana ni mpfula ni byanyi. Leyi i khalendara ya ku tswalisa ya xitichi xin'we, ku nga ri tin'hweti ta ntshovelo wa nyama ya nyimpfu. Fananisa swifuwo swa nyama leswi tolovelaka ndhawu ni swakudya swa ndhawu, kutani u rhekhoda ku tswariwa, ku hanya, ku lumuriwa ni ku tlhaviwa kumbe ku xavisiwa ka xiviri; swinyimpfana leswi tswariweke hi nyimpfu ya xisati a hi kg leti dyiwaka.
rows.ve: Bugu ya muvhuso ya nngu i ṱalusa u bebisa hu langwaho ngei Mara Research Station, Limpopo: u ṱangana ha u bebisa nga Fulwi–Fulwana na u beba nga Ḽara–Nyendavhusiku u itela u anḓana na mvula na hatsi. Iyi ndi khalenda ya u bebisa ya tshiṱitshi tshithihi, hu si miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ya ṋama ya nngu. Vhambedzani zwipuka zwa ṋama zwo ḓowelaho fhethu na zwiḽiwa zwa henefho, ni kone u ṅwala u bebwa, u tshila, u lumulwa na u ṱhavhiwa kana u rengiswa ha vhukuma; zwingwana zwo bebwaho nga nngu ya tshisadzi a si kg i ḽiwaho.

rows.english: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.
rows.zu: Ububanzi bamadlelo omile ngokwengxenye/abanzi (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) busetshenziswa njengenani eliyinhloko; inani elingu-8 kg/year lomusho ofanayo lingelohlelo oluhlukile (izimvu eziklaba amadlelo ATSHALIWE) futhi likhishwa ngamabomu kububanzi kunokuba lifakwe esilinganisweni. Isabelomali esihlukile se-Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) sohlobo lokufuya lwe-Dohne Merino Extensive (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) sibika ngokwehlukana uboya obuthengisiwe bomhlambi bonke obungu-4439.64 kg obuvela emhlambini wama-Smallstock Units angu-'1 519', okungukuthi 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - akusetshenziswa njengenani eliyinhloko ngoba umthombo awusho ukuthi 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 imvu (i-SSU yisisindo esilinganiselwe sesigaba semfuyo, hhayi isibalo sangempela samakhanda), ngakho ukuguqulela ku-kg/sheep kungadinga isici sokuguqula esingashiwongo. Elinye iphepha le-NWGA/Mandela Initiative elikhuluma nge-Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program libika ukuhlolwa kwenzalo kwe-Grootfontein ADI okuthi 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [izinqama zokuhweba] 2.4 [izinqama zomphakathi]' kwemihlambi yomphakathi yase-Eastern Cape - akuhlanganiswa nenani eliyinhloko ngoba lelo thebula lithi ngqo 'amawundlu anezinyanga ezingu-6' (isigaba sokuphila esihlukile eboyeni bonyaka ogcwele bemvu esikhulile), okuhambisana nomthetho wokungaxutshi izibalo zezigaba zokuphila ezihlukene; kugcinwa lapha kuphela njengomongo womphakathi wase-EC: amawundlu ayinzalo yezinqama zokuhweba anezinyanga ezingu-6 ayenesilinganiso esingu-2.8 kg, ayinzalo yezinqama zomphakathi 2.4 kg, umehluko ka-+16%.
rows.st: Moedi wa makgulo a batlang a omme/a maholo (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) o sebediswa e le palo e ka sehloohong; palo ya 8 kg/year polelong e tshwanang ke ya mokgwa o fapaneng (dinku tse fulang makgulong a LENGWENG) mme e tlohetswe ka boomo moeding ho ena le ho kenngwa karolelanong. Tekanyetso e fapaneng ya kgwebo ya Dohne Merino Extensive ya Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) e tlaleha ka thoko boya bohle ba mohlape bo rekisitsweng ba 4439.64 kg ho tswa mohlapeng wa '1 519' Smallstock Units, ke hore 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - ha e sebediswe e le palo e ka sehloohong hobane mohlodi ha o bolele hore 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 nku (SSU ke boima bo lekantsweng ba sehlopha sa diphoofolo, eseng palo ya nnete ya dihlooho), kahoo ho fetolela ho kg/sheep ho ka hloka ntlha ya phetoho e sa bolelwang. Pampiri e nngwe ya NWGA/Mandela Initiative ka Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program e tlaleha teko ya bana ya Grootfontein ADI ya 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [dipheleu tsa kgwebo] 2.4 [dipheleu tsa kopanelo]' bakeng sa mehlape ya kopanelo ya Eastern Cape - ha e kopantswe le palo e ka sehloohong hobane tafole eo e bolela ka ho hlaka 'dikonyana tsa dikgwedi tse 6' (mohato wa bophelo o fapaneng le boya bohle ba selemo ba nku e hodileng), ho tsamaellana le molao wa ho se kopanye dipalo tsa mekgahlelo e fapaneng ya bophelo; e bolokilwe mona feela e le moelelo wa kopanelo wa EC: dikonyana tsa dipheleu tsa kgwebo tsa dikgwedi tse 6 di ne di na le karolelano ya 2.8 kg, tsa dipheleu tsa kopanelo 2.4 kg, phapang ya +16%.
rows.ts: Mpimo wa madyelo lama omeke hi xiphemu/lama anameke (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) wu tirhisiwa wu ri nhlayo leyikulu; nhlayo ya 8 kg/year ya xivulwa xin'we i ya mafambiselo man'wana (tinyimpfu leti dyaka madyelo lama RIMIWEKE) naswona yi susiwa hi vomu eka mpimo ematshan'wini yo hlanganisiwa eka avhareji. Mpimanyeto wun'wana wa bindzu wa Dohne Merino Extensive wa Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) wu vika hi ku hambana voya hinkwabyo bya ntlhambi byi xavisiweke bya 4439.64 kg ku suka eka ntlhambi wa '1 519' Smallstock Units, hi leswaku 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - a swi tirhisiwi swi ri nhlayo leyikulu hikuva xihlovo a xi vuli leswaku 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 nyimpfu (SSU i ntikelo lowu ringanisiweke wa ntlawa wa swifuwo, ku nga ri nhlayo ya xiviri ya tinhloko), hikokwalaho ku hundzurulela eka kg/sheep swi ta lava mpimo wo hundzula lowu nga boxiwangiki. Phepha rin'wana ra NWGA/Mandela Initiative ra Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program ri vika ndzavisiso wa vana wa Grootfontein ADI wa 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [makhuna ya mabindzu] 2.4 [makhuna ya vaaki]' eka mintlhambi ya vaaki ya Eastern Cape - a swi hlanganisiwi ni nhlayo leyikulu hikuva tafula rero ri vula hi ku kongoma 'swinyimpfana swa tin'hweti ta 6' (xiyimo xa ku hanya lexi hambaneke ni voya hinkwabyo bya lembe bya nyimpfu leyi kuleke), swi fambelanaka ni nawu wo ka ku nga hlanganisiwi tinhlayo ta swiyimo swo hambana swa ku hanya; swi hlayisiwa laha ntsena swi ri mongo wa vaaki wa EC: swinyimpfana leswi tswariweke hi makhuna ya mabindzu eka tin'hweti ta 6 a swi ri ni avhareji ya 2.8 kg, leswi tswariweke hi makhuna ya vaaki 2.4 kg, ku hambana ka +16%.
rows.ve: Mikhano ya mafulo o omaho zwiṱuku/mahulwane (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) i shumiswa sa mbalo khulwane; mbalo ya 8 kg/year ya fhungo ḽithihi ndi ya maitele o fhambanaho (nngu dzi fulaho mafulo O ṰAVHIWAHO) nahone yo litshwa nga khole kha mikhano nṱhani ha u ṱanganyiswa kha avhareji. Iṅwe mugaganyagwama wa bindu wa Dohne Merino Extensive wa Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) i vhiga nga thungo vhukuse hoṱhe ha muṱambi ho rengiswaho ha 4439.64 kg hu bvaho kha muṱambi wa '1 519' Smallstock Units, zwine zwa amba 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - a zwi shumiswi sa mbalo khulwane ngauri tshiko a tshi buli uri 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 nngu (SSU ndi tshileme tsho linganyiswaho tsha tshigwada tsha zwipuka, hu si tshivhalo tsha vhukuma tsha ṱhoho), ngauralo u shandukisela kha kg/sheep zwi ḓo ṱoḓa tshikalo tsha u shandukisa tshi songo bulwaho. Ḽiṅwe bammbiri ḽa NWGA/Mandela Initiative ḽa Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program ḽi vhiga mulingo wa vhana wa Grootfontein ADI wa 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [khonḓo dza mabindu] 2.4 [khonḓo dza tshitshavha]' kha miṱambi ya tshitshavha ya Eastern Cape - a zwi ṱanganyiswi na mbalo khulwane ngauri thebuḽa iḽo ḽi bula nga ho livhaho 'zwingwana zwa miṅwedzi ya 6' (ḽiga ḽa vhutshilo ḽo fhambanaho na vhukuse hoṱhe ha ṅwaha ha nngu yo aluwaho), zwi anḓanaho na mulayo wa u sa ṱanganyisa mbalo dza zwiga zwa vhutshilo zwo fhambanaho; zwi vhulungwa afha fhedzi sa mafhungo a tshitshavha a EC: zwingwana zwo bebwaho nga khonḓo dza mabindu kha miṅwedzi ya 6 zwo vha na avhareji ya 2.8 kg, zwo bebwaho nga khonḓo dza tshitshavha 2.4 kg, phambano ya +16%.
